callingMaterial.optionReq.15: level 5, hex or a curse feature
callingMaterial.optionReq.19: level 7, hex or a curse feature
callingMaterial.option.0.name: Agonizing Blast
callingMaterial.option.0.description: Add your Charisma modifier to the damage of each Eldritch Blast beam. Usually the first invocation a warlock takes.
callingMaterial.option.1.name: Armor of Shadows
callingMaterial.option.1.description: Cast mage armor on yourself at will, without a spell slot.
callingMaterial.option.2.name: Ascendant Step
callingMaterial.option.2.description: Cast levitate on yourself at will, without a spell slot.
callingMaterial.option.3.name: Aspect of the Moon
callingMaterial.option.3.description: You no longer need to sleep and cannot be forced to. You keep watch through the whole night.
callingMaterial.option.4.name: Beast Speech
callingMaterial.option.4.description: Cast speak with animals at will, without a spell slot.
callingMaterial.option.5.name: Beguiling Influence
callingMaterial.option.5.description: You gain proficiency in Deception and Persuasion.
callingMaterial.option.6.name: Bewitching Whispers
callingMaterial.option.6.description: Cast compulsion once per long rest using a warlock spell slot.
callingMaterial.option.7.name: Book of Ancient Secrets
callingMaterial.option.7.description: Inscribe two 1st-level rituals in your Book of Shadows and cast them as rituals. You can add more rituals you find.
callingMaterial.option.8.name: Chains of Carceri
callingMaterial.option.8.description: Cast hold monster at will on a celestial, fiend or elemental, without a slot, once per creature per long rest.
callingMaterial.option.9.name: Cloak of Flies
callingMaterial.option.9.description: A bonus action wraps you in buzzing flies for a minute: advantage on Intimidation, disadvantage on other Charisma checks, and poison damage to creatures that end their turn within 5 feet.
callingMaterial.option.10.name: Devil's Sight
callingMaterial.option.10.description: You see normally in darkness, magical and nonmagical, out to 120 feet. Pairs famously with casting darkness on yourself.
callingMaterial.option.11.name: Dreadful Word
callingMaterial.option.11.description: Cast confusion once per long rest using a warlock spell slot.
callingMaterial.option.12.name: Eldritch Mind
callingMaterial.option.12.description: You have advantage on Constitution saving throws to maintain concentration on a spell.
callingMaterial.option.13.name: Eldritch Sight
callingMaterial.option.13.description: Cast detect magic at will, without a spell slot.
callingMaterial.option.14.name: Eldritch Spear
callingMaterial.option.14.description: Your Eldritch Blast reaches 300 feet instead of 120.
callingMaterial.option.15.name: Eyes of the Rune Keeper
callingMaterial.option.16.name: Fiendish Vigor
callingMaterial.option.16.description: Cast false life on yourself at will as a 1st-level spell, without a slot.
callingMaterial.option.17.name: Gaze of Two Minds
callingMaterial.option.17.description: Touch a willing humanoid and perceive through its senses until the end of your next turn, extendable each turn.
callingMaterial.option.18.name: Ghostly Gaze
callingMaterial.option.18.description: As an action, see through solid objects out to 30 feet for a minute, once per short or long rest.
callingMaterial.option.19.name: Gift of the Depths
callingMaterial.option.19.description: You can breathe underwater, gain a swimming speed equal to your walking speed, and cast water breathing once per long rest without a slot.
callingMaterial.option.20.name: Gift of the Ever-Living Ones
callingMaterial.option.20.description: Whenever you regain hit points while your familiar is within 100 feet, you regain the maximum possible.
callingMaterial.option.21.name: Grasp of Hadar
callingMaterial.option.21.description: Once per turn when Eldritch Blast hits, you can pull the target 10 feet toward you.
callingMaterial.option.22.name: Improved Pact Weapon
callingMaterial.option.22.description: Your pact weapon counts as magical, gives +1 to attack and damage, and can serve as your spellcasting focus. You can also make a bow or crossbow your pact weapon.
callingMaterial.option.23.name: Investment of the Chain Master
callingMaterial.option.23.description: Your familiar gains a flying or swimming speed, its attacks count as magical, it can be commanded as a bonus action, and it can impose your spell save DC on its effects.
callingMaterial.option.24.name: Lifedrinker
callingMaterial.option.24.description: Your pact weapon deals extra necrotic damage equal to your Charisma modifier on a hit.
callingMaterial.option.25.name: Maddening Hex
callingMaterial.option.25.description: A bonus action deals psychic damage equal to your Charisma modifier to your hex target and every creature within 5 feet of it.
callingMaterial.option.26.name: Mask of Many Faces
callingMaterial.option.26.description: Cast disguise self at will, without a spell slot.
callingMaterial.option.27.name: Master of Myriad Forms
callingMaterial.option.27.description: Cast alter self at will, without a spell slot.
callingMaterial.option.28.name: Minions of Chaos
callingMaterial.option.28.description: Cast conjure elemental once per long rest using a warlock spell slot.
callingMaterial.option.29.name: Mire the Mind
callingMaterial.option.29.description: Cast slow once per long rest using a warlock spell slot.
callingMaterial.option.30.name: Misty Visions
callingMaterial.option.30.description: Cast silent image at will, without a spell slot.
callingMaterial.option.31.name: One with Shadows
callingMaterial.option.31.description: In dim light or darkness, become invisible as an action until you move or act.
callingMaterial.option.32.name: Otherworldly Leap
callingMaterial.option.32.description: Cast jump on yourself at will, without a spell slot.
callingMaterial.option.33.name: Protection of the Talisman
callingMaterial.option.33.description: The wearer of your talisman can add a d4 to a failed saving throw, a proficiency-bonus number of times per long rest.
callingMaterial.option.34.name: Rebuke of the Talisman
callingMaterial.option.34.description: When the wearer of your talisman is hit, you can use a reaction to deal psychic damage equal to your proficiency bonus and push the attacker 10 feet.
callingMaterial.option.35.name: Relentless Hex
callingMaterial.option.35.description: A bonus action teleports you up to 30 feet to a space near your cursed target.
callingMaterial.option.36.name: Repelling Blast
callingMaterial.option.36.description: Once per turn when Eldritch Blast hits, you can push the target 10 feet away. Excellent battlefield control.
callingMaterial.option.37.name: Sculptor of Flesh
callingMaterial.option.37.description: Cast polymorph once per long rest using a warlock spell slot.
callingMaterial.option.38.name: Shroud of Shadow
callingMaterial.option.38.description: Cast invisibility at will, without a spell slot.
callingMaterial.option.39.name: Sign of Ill Omen
callingMaterial.option.39.description: Cast bestow curse once per long rest using a warlock spell slot.
callingMaterial.option.40.name: Thief of Five Fates
callingMaterial.option.40.description: Cast bane once per long rest using a warlock spell slot.
callingMaterial.option.41.name: Thirsting Blade
callingMaterial.option.41.description: You attack twice with your pact weapon whenever you take the Attack action.
callingMaterial.option.42.name: Tomb of Levistus
callingMaterial.option.42.description: As a reaction on taking damage, encase yourself in ice for temporary hit points, at the cost of being restrained and taking cold damage; once per short or long rest.
callingMaterial.option.43.name: Trickster's Escape
callingMaterial.option.43.description: Cast freedom of movement on yourself once per long rest, without a slot.
callingMaterial.option.44.name: Visions of Distant Realms
callingMaterial.option.44.description: Cast arcane eye at will, without a spell slot.
callingMaterial.option.45.name: Voice of the Chain Master
callingMaterial.option.45.description: You can speak through your familiar, perceive through its senses, and communicate with it at any distance on the same plane.
callingMaterial.option.46.name: Whispers of the Grave
callingMaterial.option.46.description: Cast speak with dead at will, without a spell slot.
callingMaterial.option.47.name: Witch Sight
callingMaterial.option.47.description: You see the true form of any shapechanger or creature concealed by illusion within 30 feet.
callingMaterial.option.48.name: Pact of the Blade
callingMaterial.option.48.description: You can conjure a magical weapon of any kind as an action, and it counts as magical. This is the melee warlock's pact.
callingMaterial.option.49.name: Pact of the Chain
callingMaterial.option.49.description: You learn find familiar and can take special forms such as an imp, quasit, pseudodragon or sprite, and your familiar can attack with its own reaction.
callingMaterial.option.50.name: Pact of the Tome
callingMaterial.option.50.description: You gain a Book of Shadows holding three cantrips from any class's list, which you can cast at will.
callingMaterial.option.51.name: Pact of the Talisman
callingMaterial.option.51.description: You gain an amulet that lets its wearer add a d4 to a failed ability check, a proficiency-bonus number of times per long rest.
callingMaterial.option.52.name: Ambush
callingMaterial.option.52.description: Spend a die to add it to a Stealth check or an initiative roll.
callingMaterial.option.53.name: Bait and Switch
callingMaterial.option.53.description: Spend a die to swap places with a willing ally within 5 feet, and one of you adds the die to your AC until your next turn.
callingMaterial.option.54.name: Brace
callingMaterial.option.54.description: As a reaction when a creature moves into your reach, spend a die to attack it and add the die to the damage.
callingMaterial.option.55.name: Commander's Strike
callingMaterial.option.55.description: Give up one of your attacks and spend a die to let an ally use their reaction to attack, adding the die to their damage.
callingMaterial.option.56.name: Commanding Presence
callingMaterial.option.56.description: Spend a die to add it to an Intimidation, Performance or Persuasion check.
callingMaterial.option.57.name: Disarming Attack
callingMaterial.option.57.description: Spend a die to add it to the damage and force a Strength save, dropping one item the target is holding.
callingMaterial.option.58.name: Distracting Strike
callingMaterial.option.58.description: Spend a die to add it to the damage and give the next attacker advantage against the target.
callingMaterial.option.59.name: Evasive Footwork
callingMaterial.option.59.description: Spend a die and add it to your AC while you move.
callingMaterial.option.60.name: Feinting Attack
callingMaterial.option.60.description: A bonus action feints at a creature within 5 feet, giving you advantage on your next attack against it and adding the die to the damage.
callingMaterial.option.61.name: Goading Attack
callingMaterial.option.61.description: Spend a die to add it to the damage and force a Wisdom save, giving the target disadvantage on attacks against anyone but you.
callingMaterial.option.62.name: Grappling Strike
callingMaterial.option.62.description: After hitting, spend a die as a bonus action to attempt a grapple, adding the die to your check.
callingMaterial.option.63.name: Lunging Attack
callingMaterial.option.63.description: Spend a die to reach 5 feet further with a melee attack and add the die to the damage.
callingMaterial.option.64.name: Maneuvering Attack
callingMaterial.option.64.description: Spend a die to add it to the damage and let an ally move half their speed without provoking from the target.
callingMaterial.option.65.name: Menacing Attack
callingMaterial.option.65.description: Spend a die to add it to the damage and frighten the target on a failed Wisdom save.
callingMaterial.option.66.name: Parry
callingMaterial.option.66.description: As a reaction, spend a die to reduce melee damage to you by the die plus your Dexterity modifier.
callingMaterial.option.67.name: Precision Attack
callingMaterial.option.67.description: Spend a die to add it to an attack roll, before or after seeing whether it hits.
callingMaterial.option.68.name: Pushing Attack
callingMaterial.option.68.description: Spend a die to add it to the damage and push a Large or smaller target 15 feet on a failed Strength save.
callingMaterial.option.69.name: Quick Toss
callingMaterial.option.69.description: A bonus action draws and throws a weapon, spending a die to add it to the damage.
callingMaterial.option.70.name: Rally
callingMaterial.option.70.description: A bonus action grants an ally temporary hit points equal to the die plus your Charisma modifier.
callingMaterial.option.71.name: Riposte
callingMaterial.option.71.description: As a reaction when a creature misses you in melee, spend a die to attack it and add the die to the damage.
callingMaterial.option.72.name: Sweeping Attack
callingMaterial.option.72.description: After hitting, spend a die to deal that much damage to a second creature within 5 feet of the first.
callingMaterial.option.73.name: Tactical Assessment
callingMaterial.option.73.description: Spend a die to add it to a History, Insight or Investigation check.
callingMaterial.option.74.name: Trip Attack
callingMaterial.option.74.description: Spend a die to add it to the damage and knock a Large or smaller target prone on a failed Strength save.
callingMaterial.option.75.name: Careful Spell
callingMaterial.option.75.description: Spend 1 sorcery point to let a number of creatures equal to your Charisma modifier automatically succeed on the spell's saving throw.
callingMaterial.option.76.name: Distant Spell
callingMaterial.option.76.description: Spend 1 sorcery point to double a spell's range, or give a touch spell 30 feet of reach.
callingMaterial.option.77.name: Empowered Spell
callingMaterial.option.77.description: Spend 1 sorcery point to reroll damage dice equal to your Charisma modifier.
callingMaterial.option.78.name: Extended Spell
callingMaterial.option.78.description: Spend 1 sorcery point to double a spell's duration, up to 24 hours.
callingMaterial.option.79.name: Heightened Spell
callingMaterial.option.79.description: Spend 3 sorcery points to give one target disadvantage on its first saving throw against the spell.
callingMaterial.option.80.name: Quickened Spell
callingMaterial.option.80.description: Spend 2 sorcery points to cast a one-action spell as a bonus action instead.
callingMaterial.option.81.name: Seeking Spell
callingMaterial.option.81.description: Spend 2 sorcery points to reroll a missed attack roll for a spell.
callingMaterial.option.82.name: Subtle Spell
callingMaterial.option.82.description: Spend 1 sorcery point to cast without verbal or somatic components, which no one can see or hear you do.
callingMaterial.option.83.name: Transmuted Spell
callingMaterial.option.83.description: Spend 1 sorcery point to change a spell's damage type among acid, cold, fire, lightning, poison and thunder.
callingMaterial.option.84.name: Twinned Spell
callingMaterial.option.84.description: Spend sorcery points equal to the spell's level to have a single-target spell hit a second creature.
callingMaterial.option.85.name: Arcane Propulsion Armor
callingMaterial.option.85.description: Armor that raises the wearer's speed by 5 feet, grants a returning gauntlet attack, and replaces missing limbs.
callingMaterial.option.86.name: Armor of Magical Strength
callingMaterial.option.86.description: Armor that lets the wearer use Intelligence for Strength checks and saves, and spend charges to add to a save or avoid being knocked prone.
callingMaterial.option.87.name: Boots of the Winding Path
callingMaterial.option.87.description: Boots that let the wearer teleport back to a space they occupied earlier in the turn.
callingMaterial.option.88.name: Enhanced Arcane Focus
callingMaterial.option.88.description: A focus granting +1 to spell attack rolls and letting spells ignore half cover.
callingMaterial.option.89.name: Enhanced Defense
callingMaterial.option.89.description: Armor or a shield with a +1 bonus to AC, rising to +2 at higher levels.
callingMaterial.option.90.name: Enhanced Weapon
callingMaterial.option.90.description: A weapon with a +1 bonus to attack and damage, rising to +2 at higher levels.
callingMaterial.option.91.name: Helm of Awareness
callingMaterial.option.91.description: A helm granting advantage on initiative rolls.
callingMaterial.option.92.name: Homunculus Servant
callingMaterial.option.92.description: A tiny construct companion that acts on your turn, scouts, and channels your spells.
callingMaterial.option.93.name: Mind Sharpener
callingMaterial.option.93.description: A garment with charges that turn a failed concentration save into a success.
callingMaterial.option.94.name: Radiant Weapon
callingMaterial.option.94.description: A weapon that sheds light, grants +1 to attack and damage, and can blind an attacker as a reaction.
callingMaterial.option.95.name: Repeating Shot
callingMaterial.option.95.description: A ranged weapon with +1 to attack and damage that produces its own ammunition.
callingMaterial.option.96.name: Replicate Magic Item
callingMaterial.option.96.description: Reproduce a common magic item from the artificer's replicable list; the list grows with your level.
callingMaterial.option.97.name: Repulsion Shield
callingMaterial.option.97.description: A shield with +1 AC and charges that push an attacker 15 feet away.
callingMaterial.option.98.name: Resistant Armor
callingMaterial.option.98.description: Armor granting resistance to one damage type of your choice.
callingMaterial.option.99.name: Returning Weapon
callingMaterial.option.99.description: A thrown weapon with +1 to attack and damage that flies back to the wielder's hand.
callingMaterial.option.100.name: Spell-Refueling Ring
callingMaterial.option.100.description: A ring that restores one expended spell slot of 3rd level or lower once per day.
callingMaterial.option.101.name: Cloud Rune
callingMaterial.option.101.description: Advantage on Sleight of Hand and Deception. Invoke it as a reaction to redirect an attack from one creature to another within 30 feet.
callingMaterial.option.102.name: Fire Rune
callingMaterial.option.102.description: Doubled proficiency on tool checks. Invoke it on a hit for extra fire damage and to bind the target in fiery chains, restraining it.
callingMaterial.option.103.name: Frost Rune
callingMaterial.option.103.description: Advantage on Animal Handling and Intimidation. Invoke it for a bonus to Strength and Constitution checks and saves for 10 minutes.
callingMaterial.option.104.name: Hill Rune
callingMaterial.option.104.description: Advantage on saving throws against poison and resistance to poison damage. Invoke it to gain resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage for a minute.
callingMaterial.option.105.name: Stone Rune
callingMaterial.option.105.description: Advantage on Insight and darkvision to 120 feet. Invoke it as a reaction to charm a creature within 30 feet that fails a Wisdom save.
callingMaterial.option.106.name: Storm Rune
callingMaterial.option.106.description: Advantage on Arcana and you cannot be surprised while conscious. Invoke it to see glimpses of the future, granting advantage or imposing disadvantage on rolls near you.
callingMaterial.option.107.name: Breath of Winter
callingMaterial.option.107.description: Spend 6 ki to cast cone of cold.
callingMaterial.option.108.name: Clench of the North Wind
callingMaterial.option.108.description: Spend 3 ki to cast hold person.
callingMaterial.option.109.name: Elemental Attunement
callingMaterial.option.109.description: A minor elemental trick: snuff or light a flame, chill or warm an object, or shape a Medium mass of earth, fire, water or mist for a moment.
callingMaterial.option.110.name: Eternal Mountain Defense
callingMaterial.option.110.description: Spend 5 ki to cast stoneskin on yourself.
callingMaterial.option.111.name: Fangs of the Fire Snake
callingMaterial.option.111.description: Spend 1 ki when you take the Attack action to add 10 feet of reach and fire damage to your unarmed strikes.
callingMaterial.option.112.name: Fist of Four Thunders
callingMaterial.option.113.name: Fist of Unbroken Air
callingMaterial.option.113.description: Spend 2 ki to strike a creature within 30 feet for 3d10 bludgeoning damage, pushing and knocking it prone on a failed Strength save.
callingMaterial.option.114.name: Flames of the Phoenix
callingMaterial.option.115.name: Gong of the Summit
callingMaterial.option.116.name: Mist Stance
callingMaterial.option.116.description: Spend 4 ki to cast gaseous form on yourself.
callingMaterial.option.117.name: Ride the Wind
callingMaterial.option.117.description: Spend 4 ki to cast fly on yourself.
callingMaterial.option.118.name: River of Hungry Flame
callingMaterial.option.118.description: Spend 5 ki to cast wall of fire.
callingMaterial.option.119.name: Rush of the Gale Spirits
callingMaterial.option.119.description: Spend 2 ki to cast gust of wind.
callingMaterial.option.120.name: Shape the Flowing River
callingMaterial.option.120.description: Spend 1 ki to freeze, thaw or reshape a 30-foot area of water or ice.
callingMaterial.option.121.name: Sweeping Cinder Strike
callingMaterial.option.121.description: Spend 2 ki to cast burning hands.
callingMaterial.option.122.name: Water Whip
callingMaterial.option.122.description: Spend 2 ki to lash a creature within 30 feet for 3d10 bludgeoning damage, then pull it 25 feet or knock it prone on a failed Dexterity save.
callingMaterial.option.123.name: Wave of Rolling Earth
callingMaterial.option.123.description: Spend 6 ki to cast wall of stone.
callingMaterial.option.124.name: Colossus Slayer
callingMaterial.option.124.description: Once per turn, a weapon hit on a creature already below its hit point maximum deals an extra 1d8 damage.
callingMaterial.option.125.name: Giant Killer
callingMaterial.option.125.description: When a Large or larger creature within 5 feet hits or misses you with an attack, your reaction makes an attack against it right after.
callingMaterial.option.126.name: Horde Breaker
callingMaterial.option.126.description: Once on each of your turns when you make a weapon attack, you can make another attack with the same weapon against a different creature within 5 feet of the first target and in range.
callingMaterial.option.127.name: Escape the Horde
callingMaterial.option.127.description: Opportunity attacks against you are made with disadvantage.
callingMaterial.option.128.name: Multiattack Defense
callingMaterial.option.128.description: After a creature hits you with an attack, you gain +4 AC against all its later attacks this turn.
callingMaterial.option.129.name: Steel Will
callingMaterial.option.129.description: Advantage on saving throws against being frightened.
callingMaterial.option.130.name: Volley
callingMaterial.option.130.description: As an action, a ranged weapon attack against any number of creatures within 10 feet of a point you can see in range, with a separate attack roll for each.
callingMaterial.option.131.name: Whirlwind Attack
callingMaterial.option.131.description: As an action, a melee attack against any number of creatures within 5 feet of you, with a separate attack roll for each.
callingMaterial.option.132.name: Evasion
callingMaterial.option.132.description: On a Dexterity save for half damage, you take none on a success and half on a failure.
callingMaterial.option.133.name: Stand Against the Tide
callingMaterial.option.133.description: When a hostile creature misses you with a melee attack, your reaction can make it repeat the attack against another creature of your choice.
callingMaterial.option.134.name: Uncanny Dodge
callingMaterial.option.134.description: When an attacker you can see hits you with an attack, your reaction halves the attack's damage against you.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.0.name: Additional Fighting Style
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.0.descript: You pick a second Fighting Style, and both apply at once.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.1.name: Additional Magical Secrets
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.1.descript: You learn two more spells from any class's list. They count as bard spells for you.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.2.name: Arcane Tradition
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.2.descript: The marker for choosing your wizard school. The school you pick supplies the actual abilities.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.3.name: Archdruid
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.3.descript: You can Wild Shape as often as you like, and your druid spells no longer need spoken or gestured components.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.4.name: Artificer Specialist
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.4.descript: The marker for choosing your artificer specialty. The specialty you pick supplies the actual abilities.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.5.name: Aura Improvements
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.5.descript: Your paladin auras reach 30 feet instead of 10, so they cover most of the party in a fight.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.6.name: Aura of Courage
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.6.descript: You and allies within range cannot be frightened while you are conscious.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.7.name: Aura of Devotion
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.7.descript: You and allies within range cannot be charmed while you are conscious.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.8.name: Bard College
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.8.descript: The marker for choosing your bard college. The college you pick supplies the actual abilities.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.9.name: Beast Spells
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.9.descript: While you are Wild Shaped into a beast, you can still cast your druid spells.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.10.name: Blessed Healer
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.10.descrip: When you heal someone else with a spell, you also heal yourself a little.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.11.name: Blindsense
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.11.descrip: You know the location of any hidden or invisible creature within 10 feet, as long as you can hear.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.12.name: Bonus Cantrip
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.12.descrip: You learn one extra cantrip from your class's spell list.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.13.name: Bonus Proficiencies (Lore)
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.13.descrip: You gain proficiency in three skills of your choice.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.14.name: Bonus Proficiencies (Tempest)
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.14.descrip: You can use martial weapons and wear heavy armor.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.15.name: Bonus Proficiency (heavy armor)
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.15.descrip: You can wear heavy armor without penalty.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.16.name: Circle Spells
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.16.descrip: Extra spells tied to your circle. They are always prepared and do not count against the number you can prepare.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.17.name: Cleansing Touch
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.17.descrip: You can end one spell affecting yourself or a creature you touch, a few times per long rest.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.18.name: Countercharm
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.18.descrip: As an action, you perform for a moment and give yourself and nearby allies advantage on saves against being frightened or charmed.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.19.name: Cunning Action
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.19.descrip: Each turn you can Dash, Disengage or Hide as a bonus action, on top of your normal action.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.20.name: Cutting Words
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.20.descrip: As a reaction, spend a Bardic Inspiration die to subtract it from an enemy's attack roll, ability check or damage roll.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.21.name: Dark One's Blessing
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.21.descrip: When you drop an enemy to 0 hit points, you gain temporary hit points.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.22.name: Dark One's Own Luck
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.22.descrip: Once per short or long rest, add a d10 to an ability check or saving throw after rolling.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.23.name: Defensive Tactics
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.23.descrip: A defensive option from your ranger archetype: shrug off multiattacks, escape opportunity attacks, or resist being frightened by beasts.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.24.name: Deflect Missiles
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.24.descrip: As a reaction, reduce the damage of a ranged weapon attack; if you reduce it to 0 you can throw the missile back.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.25.name: Destroy Undead (CR 1)
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.25.descrip: Turning now destroys undead up to challenge rating 1 outright.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.26.name: Destroy Undead (CR 1/2)
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.26.descrip: Weak undead you turn with Channel Divinity are destroyed outright instead of merely fleeing.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.27.name: Destroy Undead (CR 2)
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.27.descrip: Turning now destroys undead up to challenge rating 2 outright.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.28.name: Destroy Undead (CR 3)
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.28.descrip: Turning now destroys undead up to challenge rating 3 outright.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.29.name: Destroy Undead (CR 4)
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.29.descrip: Turning now destroys undead up to challenge rating 4 outright.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.30.name: Diamond Soul
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.30.descrip: You are proficient in every saving throw, and can spend ki to reroll one you fail.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.31.name: Disciple of Life
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.31.descrip: Your healing spells restore extra hit points, scaling with the spell's level.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.32.name: Divine Domain
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.32.descrip: The marker for choosing your cleric domain. The domain you pick supplies the actual abilities.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.33.name: Divine Health
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.34.name: Divine Intervention
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.34.descrip: Once per long rest you can call on your god for direct aid. Success is not guaranteed at first, and the DM decides what arrives.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.35.name: Divine Intervention Improvement
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.35.descrip: Your call for divine aid now always works.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.36.name: Divine Strike
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.36.descrip: Once per turn, your weapon hits deal an extra damage die of your domain's type. The die grows at higher levels.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.37.name: Draconic Presence
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.37.descrip: You can spend sorcery points to awe or terrify creatures around you, charming or frightening those who fail a save.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.38.name: Draconic Resilience
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.38.descrip: Your hit point maximum rises with your level, and with no armor your AC is 13 plus your Dexterity modifier.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.39.name: Dragon Ancestor
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.39.descrip: You choose a kind of dragon. It sets the damage type your bloodline favours, and you can speak Draconic.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.40.name: Dragon Wings
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.40.descrip: As a bonus action you sprout wings and gain a flying speed equal to your walking speed.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.41.name: Druid Circle
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.41.descrip: The marker for choosing your druid circle. The circle you pick supplies the actual abilities.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.42.name: Druidic
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.42.descrip: You know the secret language of druids and can leave hidden messages only other druids notice.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.43.name: Eldritch Invocations
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.43.descrip: Permanent magical perks you choose and can swap when you level: at-will spells, better Eldritch Blast, darkvision and more.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.44.name: Eldritch Master
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.44.descrip: Once per long rest you can spend a minute pleading with your patron to regain all your Pact Magic spell slots.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.45.name: Elemental Affinity
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.45.descrip: Add your Charisma modifier to the damage of spells matching your dragon ancestor, and spend a sorcery point for resistance to that damage.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.46.name: Elusive
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.46.descrip: No attack roll against you has advantage while you are conscious.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.47.name: Empowered Evocation
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.47.descrip: Add your Intelligence modifier to the damage of your evocation spells.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.48.name: Empty Body
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.48.descrip: Spend ki to turn invisible for a minute, or spend more to cast astral projection without components.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.49.name: Evocation Savant
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.49.descrip: Copying evocation spells into your spellbook costs half the usual time and gold.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.50.name: Expertise
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.50.descrip: You double your proficiency bonus on two skills or tools of your choice, so you rarely fail at them.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.51.name: Extra Attack
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.51.descrip: You attack twice instead of once whenever you take the Attack action.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.52.name: Fast Hands
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.52.descrip: Use your Cunning Action bonus action to make a Sleight of Hand check, use thieves' tools, or use an object.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.53.name: Favored Enemy
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.53.descrip: You have advantage on tracking a kind of creature and remembering facts about it, and you learn a related language.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.54.name: Favored Enemy Improvement
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.54.descrip: You choose an additional favored enemy and another language.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.55.name: Feral Instinct
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.55.descrip: You have advantage on initiative, and being surprised no longer stops you acting if you enter a rage first.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.56.name: Feral Senses
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.56.descrip: You can fight invisible creatures without disadvantage, and you sense unseen creatures within 30 feet.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.57.name: Fiendish Resilience
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.57.descrip: After each rest, choose a damage type; you resist it until you choose again.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.58.name: Fighting Style
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.58.descrip: A combat specialty you choose once, such as Archery for ranged accuracy or Defense for extra armor class. It applies automatically.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.59.name: Flash of Genius
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.59.descrip: As a reaction, add your Intelligence modifier to an ability check or saving throw made by you or an ally within 30 feet.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.60.name: Foe Slayer
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.60.descrip: Once per turn, add your Wisdom modifier to an attack roll or damage roll against your favored enemy.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.61.name: Font of Inspiration
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.61.descrip: Your Bardic Inspiration comes back on a short rest, not just a long one.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.62.name: Frenzy
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.62.descrip: While raging you can go into a frenzy, making a bonus-action melee attack each turn at the cost of a level of exhaustion afterwards.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.63.name: Hide in Plain Sight
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.63.descrip: Spend a minute camouflaging yourself against a solid surface for a large bonus to hiding, until you move.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.64.name: Holy Nimbus
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.64.descrip: Once per long rest, blaze with light for a minute: enemies near you take radiant damage and you resist their spells.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.65.name: Hunter's Prey
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.65.descrip: A damage option from your ranger archetype: extra damage on a wounded target, a second attack against a nearby enemy, or a bonus against large foes.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.66.name: Hurl Through Hell
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.66.descrip: Once per long rest, a creature you hit is dragged briefly through the lower planes and takes heavy psychic damage.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.67.name: Improved Divine Smite
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.67.descrip: Every melee weapon hit you land deals an extra 1d8 radiant damage, with no spell slot needed.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.68.name: Indomitable (1 use)
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.68.descrip: Once per long rest you can reroll a saving throw you failed.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.69.name: Indomitable (2 uses)
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.69.descrip: You can reroll a failed saving throw twice per long rest.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.70.name: Indomitable (3 uses)
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.70.descrip: You can reroll a failed saving throw three times per long rest.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.71.name: Indomitable Might
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.71.descrip: If a Strength check comes up lower than your Strength score, use your Strength score instead.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.72.name: Infuse Item
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.72.descrip: You know a list of infusions and can imbue mundane gear with them after a long rest, turning ordinary items into magic ones for your party.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.73.name: Intimidating Presence
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.73.descrip: As an action, frighten one creature within 30 feet that fails a Wisdom save.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.74.name: Jack of All Trades
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.74.descrip: Add half your proficiency bonus to any ability check that does not already use it, so you are decent at everything.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.75.name: Land's Stride
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.75.descrip: Difficult terrain from plants costs you no extra movement, and magical plants cannot slow or hurt you without a save.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.76.name: Magic Item Adept
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.76.descrip: You can attune to four magic items at once, and you craft common and uncommon items in a quarter of the usual time and cost.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.77.name: Magic Item Master
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.77.descrip: You can attune to six magic items at once.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.78.name: Magic Item Savant
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.78.descrip: You can attune to five magic items at once, and you ignore all class, race, spell and level requirements on using them.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.79.name: Magical Secrets
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.79.descrip: You learn two spells from any class's list. They count as bard spells for you.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.80.name: Magical Tinkering
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.80.descrip: You imbue Tiny objects with a small magical property: light, a recorded message, a smell, or a picture. You can have as many as your Intelligence modifier.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.81.name: Martial Archetype
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.81.descrip: The marker for choosing your fighter archetype. The archetype you pick supplies the actual abilities.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.82.name: Metamagic
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.82.descrip: Ways to bend a spell as you cast it by spending sorcery points: cast it faster, at longer range, at two targets, or with a reroll on the damage.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.83.name: Metamagic Option
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.83.descrip: You learn one more Metamagic option.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.84.name: Monastic Tradition
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.84.descrip: The marker for choosing your monk tradition. The tradition you pick supplies the actual abilities.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.85.name: Multiattack
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.85.descrip: An archetype option: either a volley of ranged attacks against everyone in an area, or a whirlwind of melee attacks against everyone next to you.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.86.name: Mystic Arcanum (6th level)
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.86.descrip: One 6th-level spell your patron grants. You can cast it once per long rest without using a spell slot.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.87.name: Mystic Arcanum (7th level)
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.87.descrip: One 7th-level spell you can cast once per long rest without using a spell slot.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.88.name: Mystic Arcanum (8th level)
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.88.descrip: One 8th-level spell you can cast once per long rest without using a spell slot.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.89.name: Mystic Arcanum (9th level)
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.89.descrip: One 9th-level spell you can cast once per long rest without using a spell slot.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.90.name: Natural Explorer
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.90.descrip: In your favored terrain you travel faster, cannot get lost, stay alert while travelling, and find more food.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.91.name: Natural Explorer Improvement
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.91.descrip: You choose an additional favored terrain.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.92.name: Nature's Sanctuary
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.92.descrip: Beasts and plants must pass a save to attack you at all.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.93.name: Nature's Ward
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.93.descrip: You cannot be charmed or frightened by elementals or fey, and you are immune to poison and disease.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.94.name: Open Hand Technique
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.94.descrip: When you hit with Flurry of Blows you can also knock the target prone, push it 15 feet, or stop it taking reactions.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.95.name: Otherworldly Patron
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.95.descrip: The marker for choosing the being you made your pact with. The patron you pick supplies the actual abilities.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.96.name: Overchannel
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.96.descrip: Deal maximum damage with a damaging spell of 5th level or lower. Using it more than once between long rests hurts you badly.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.97.name: Pact Boon
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.97.descrip: A gift from your patron: a summonable weapon, a book of extra cantrips, or a familiar that can scout for you.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.98.name: Pact Magic
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.98.descrip: Warlock spellcasting. You have few slots but they are always cast at their highest level and come back on a short rest.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.99.name: Peerless Skill
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.99.descrip: Spend a Bardic Inspiration die on your own ability check.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.100.name: Perfect Self
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.100.descri: If you roll initiative with no ki left, you regain 4 ki points.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.101.name: Potent Cantrip
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.101.descri: Creatures that succeed on a saving throw against your cantrip still take half damage.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.102.name: Primal Champion
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.102.descri: Your Strength and Constitution each rise by 4, past the usual maximum of 20.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.103.name: Primal Path
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.103.descri: The marker for choosing your barbarian path. The path you pick supplies the actual abilities.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.104.name: Primeval Awareness
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.104.descri: Spend a spell slot to sense whether certain creature types are nearby, though not where or how many.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.105.name: Purity of Body
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.105.descri: You are immune to disease and poison.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.106.name: Purity of Spirit
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.106.descri: You are always under the effect of protection from evil and good, so fiends and undead struggle to touch or charm you.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.107.name: Quivering Palm
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.107.descri: Spend ki to set lethal vibrations in a creature. Later you can end them as an action, forcing a Constitution save or death.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.108.name: Ranger Archetype
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.108.descri: The marker for choosing your ranger archetype. The archetype you pick supplies the actual abilities.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.109.name: Reckless Attack
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.109.descri: Attack with abandon on your turn: you get advantage on your melee Strength attacks, but everyone has advantage against you until your next turn.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.110.name: Remarkable Athlete
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.110.descri: Add half your proficiency bonus to Strength, Dexterity and Constitution checks that do not already use it, and your running long jump is longer.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.111.name: Retaliation
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.111.descri: When a creature within 5 feet damages you, use your reaction to attack it back.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.112.name: Roguish Archetype
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.112.descri: The marker for choosing your rogue archetype. The archetype you pick supplies the actual abilities.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.113.name: Sacred Oath
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.113.descri: The marker for choosing your paladin oath. The oath you pick supplies the actual abilities.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.114.name: Sculpt Spells
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.114.descri: Choose a few creatures to automatically pass their saves against your evocation spells and take no damage, so fireballs stop hitting your friends.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.115.name: Second-Story Work
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.115.descri: Climbing costs you no extra movement, and your running jump is longer than normal.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.116.name: Signature Spells
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.116.descri: Two 3rd-level spells are always prepared and can each be cast once per short rest without a slot.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.117.name: Slippery Mind
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.117.descri: You gain proficiency in Wisdom saving throws, which are the ones that resist mind control.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.118.name: Slow Fall
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.118.descri: As a reaction, reduce falling damage by five times your monk level.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.119.name: Sorcerous Origin
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.119.descri: The marker for choosing the source of your magic. The origin you pick supplies the actual abilities.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.120.name: Sorcerous Restoration
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.120.descri: You regain 4 sorcery points on a short rest.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.121.name: Soul of Artifice
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.121.descri: You gain +1 to every saving throw per attuned magic item, and you can end one attunement as a reaction to drop to 1 hit point instead of 0.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.122.name: Spell Mastery
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.122.descri: Choose a 1st-level and a 2nd-level spell you can cast at will, without spending a slot.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.123.name: Spell-Storing Item
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.123.descri: After a long rest you store a 1st or 2nd-level artificer spell in an item, and whoever holds it can cast it a number of times based on your Intelligence.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.124.name: Spellcasting
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.124.descri: Your ability to cast spells: which list you learn from, how many spells you can have ready, and the slots you spend to cast them.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.125.name: Stillness of Mind
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.125.descri: As an action, end one effect charming or frightening you.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.126.name: Stroke of Luck
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.126.descri: Once per short or long rest, turn a missed attack into a hit or a failed ability check into a 20.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.127.name: Stunning Strike
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.127.descri: Spend 1 ki on a melee hit to stun the target until the end of your next turn unless it passes a Constitution save.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.128.name: Superior Hunter's Defense
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.128.descri: A defensive option from your ranger archetype: dodge one attack as a reaction, resist one damage type, or retaliate when an ally is hit.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.129.name: Superior Inspiration
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.129.descri: If you roll initiative with no Bardic Inspiration left, you regain one use.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.130.name: Supreme Healing
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.130.descri: Your healing spells restore the maximum possible amount instead of rolling.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.131.name: Supreme Sneak
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.131.descri: You have advantage on Stealth checks if you move no more than half your speed on your turn.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.132.name: Survivor
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.132.descri: At the start of each of your turns you regain hit points if you are below half your maximum and not at 0.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.133.name: The Right Tool for the Job
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.133.descri: With tinker's tools and an hour's work you conjure any set of artisan's tools you need, once per rest.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.134.name: Thief's Reflexes
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.134.descri: You take two turns in the first round of combat, the second at initiative minus 10.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.135.name: Thieves' Cant
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.135.descri: A secret mix of slang and signs that lets you hide messages in ordinary conversation. Only other rogues understand it.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.136.name: Tongue of the Sun and Moon
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.136.descri: You understand every spoken language, and anyone who can hear you understands what you say.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.137.name: Tool Expertise
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.137.descri: You double your proficiency bonus on any ability check using tools you are proficient with.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.138.name: Tranquility
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.138.descri: Between rests you are under a sanctuary effect: creatures must pass a save to attack you at all.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.139.name: Unarmored Defense
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.139.descri: You get a good armor class without wearing armor. The server works it out from your ability scores.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.140.name: Uncanny Dodge
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.140.descri: As a reaction, halve the damage of one attack you can see coming.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.141.name: Use Magic Device
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.141.descri: You can use any magic item, ignoring the class, race or level requirements it normally carries.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.142.name: Wholeness of Body
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.142.descri: Once per long rest, an action heals you for three times your monk level.
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.143.name: Wild Shape Improvement
callingMaterial.nativeFeature.143.descri: Your beast forms get better: a higher challenge rating, and at 8th level no restriction on swimming or flying.
callingMaterial.featureOverride.0.name: Timeless Body
callingMaterial.featureOverride.0.descri: You stop ageing outwardly and no longer need food or water.
callingMaterial.featureOverride.1.name: Timeless Body
callingMaterial.featureOverride.1.descri: You age at a tenth of the normal rate.
callingMaterial.featRequirement.2: The ability to cast at least one spell
callingMaterial.featHelp.0: Increase your Strength or Dexterity by 1, to a maximum of 20. Standing up from prone costs only 5 feet of movement, climbing costs no extra movement, and you can make a running jump after moving only 5 feet.
callingMaterial.featHelp.1: Increase your Charisma by 1, to a maximum of 20. You have advantage on Deception and Performance checks when passing yourself off as someone else, and you can mimic the speech or sounds of a creature you have heard for at least 1 minute.
callingMaterial.featHelp.2: After you Dash, you can use a bonus action to make one melee attack or to shove a creature. If you moved at least 10 feet in a straight line first, the attack deals an extra 5 damage or the shove pushes 10 extra feet.
callingMaterial.featHelp.3: You ignore the loading property of crossbows you are proficient with, being within 5 feet of a hostile creature gives you no disadvantage on ranged attacks, and when you take the Attack action with a one-handed weapon you can use a bonus action to attack with a hand crossbow you are holding.
callingMaterial.featHelp.4: When a creature hits you with a melee attack while you wield a finesse weapon you are proficient with, you can use your reaction to add your proficiency bonus to your AC against that attack, possibly turning it into a miss.
callingMaterial.featHelp.5: You gain +1 AC while wielding a separate melee weapon in each hand, you can two-weapon fight with weapons that lack the light property, and you can draw or stow two one-handed weapons at once.
callingMaterial.featHelp.6: You have advantage on Perception and Investigation checks to detect secret doors, advantage on saving throws against traps, resistance to trap damage, and you can search for traps while travelling at a normal pace.
callingMaterial.featHelp.7: Increase your Constitution by 1, to a maximum of 20. When you roll a Hit Die to regain hit points, the minimum you regain is twice your Constitution modifier.
callingMaterial.featHelp.8: Increase your Dexterity, Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma by 1, to a maximum of 20. Whenever you have advantage on an attack roll using Dexterity, Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma, you can reroll one of the dice once. The server rolls a third d20 and keeps the highest.
callingMaterial.featHelp.9: Choose acid, cold, fire, lightning or thunder. Your spells of that damage type ignore resistance, and any 1 rolled on their damage dice counts as a 2. You can take this feat more than once, choosing a different type each time.
callingMaterial.featHelp.10: On a critical hit or when you drop a creature to 0 hit points with a melee weapon, you can make one melee weapon attack as a bonus action. Before attacking with a heavy weapon you are proficient with, you can take a -5 penalty to the attack roll in exchange for +10 damage on a hit.
callingMaterial.featHelp.11: When you stabilize a creature with a healer's kit it also regains 1 hit point. As an action you can spend a use of a healer's kit to restore 1d6 + 4 hit points plus the creature's Hit Dice to a creature, once each per rest.
callingMaterial.featHelp.12: Increase your Strength by 1, to a maximum of 20, and gain proficiency with heavy armor.
callingMaterial.featHelp.13: Increase your Strength by 1, to a maximum of 20. While you wear heavy armor, bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks is reduced by 3.
callingMaterial.featHelp.14: You can spend 10 minutes rallying up to six friendly creatures within 30 feet who can hear and understand you. Each gains temporary hit points equal to your level plus your Charisma modifier, and cannot benefit again until it finishes a rest.
callingMaterial.featHelp.15: Increase your Intelligence by 1, to a maximum of 20. You always know which way is north and how many hours remain before sunrise or sunset, and you accurately recall anything you have seen or heard in the past month.
callingMaterial.featHelp.16: Increase your Strength or Dexterity by 1, to a maximum of 20, and gain proficiency with light armor.
callingMaterial.featHelp.17: Increase your Intelligence by 1, to a maximum of 20. You learn three languages and can create written ciphers that others cannot read without an Intelligence check against a DC of 8 plus your Intelligence modifier and proficiency bonus.
callingMaterial.featHelp.18: You have three luck points, regained on a long rest. Spend one to roll an extra d20 on your own attack roll, ability check or saving throw and choose which die to use, or to roll an extra d20 on an attack made against you and choose which the attacker uses.
callingMaterial.featHelp.19: Choose a class: bard, cleric, druid, sorcerer, warlock or wizard. You learn two cantrips of your choice from that class's spell list. Choose one 1st-level spell from the same list: you learn it and can cast it once without expending a spell slot, at its lowest level, and again after a long rest. Your spellcasting ability for these spells depends on the class you chose: Charisma for bard, sorcerer or warlock; Wisdom for cleric or druid; Intelligence for wizard.
callingMaterial.featHelp.20: When a creature within 5 feet casts a spell you can use your reaction to attack it. When you damage a creature concentrating on a spell it has disadvantage on the concentration save, and you have advantage on saves against spells cast by creatures within 5 feet.
callingMaterial.featHelp.21: You learn two maneuvers from the Battle Master list and gain one superiority die of d6, which refills on a short or long rest.
callingMaterial.featHelp.22: Wearing medium armor does not impose disadvantage on Stealth checks, and if your Dexterity is 16 or higher you add 3 rather than 2 to your AC from medium armor.
callingMaterial.featHelp.23: Your speed increases by 10 feet, difficult terrain costs no extra movement when you Dash, and when you make a melee attack against a creature it cannot make opportunity attacks against you for the rest of the turn.
callingMaterial.featHelp.24: Increase your Strength or Dexterity by 1, to a maximum of 20, and gain proficiency with medium armor and shields.
callingMaterial.featHelp.25: While mounted you have advantage on melee attacks against unmounted creatures smaller than your mount, you can redirect an attack aimed at your mount to yourself, and your mount takes no damage on a successful Dexterity save and half on a failure.
callingMaterial.featHelp.26: Increase your Intelligence or Wisdom by 1, to a maximum of 20. You can read lips, and you gain a +5 bonus to your passive Perception and passive Investigation.
callingMaterial.featHelp.27: When you take the Attack action with a glaive, halberd, quarterstaff or spear you can use a bonus action to strike with the opposite end for 1d4 bludgeoning damage. You also get an opportunity attack when a creature enters your reach with such a weapon.
callingMaterial.featHelp.28: Increase one ability score by 1, to a maximum of 20, and gain proficiency in saving throws with that ability.
callingMaterial.featHelp.29: You gain a ritual book holding two 1st-level ritual spells from a class you choose, and you can cast any ritual in it. You can add further rituals of a level you can cast to the book by copying them.
callingMaterial.featHelp.30: A creature you hit with an opportunity attack has its speed reduced to 0 for that turn, creatures provoke opportunity attacks from you even if they Disengage, and when a creature within 5 feet attacks someone other than you, you can use your reaction to make a melee attack against it.
callingMaterial.featHelp.31: Attacking at long range gives you no disadvantage, your ranged attacks ignore half and three-quarters cover, and before a ranged attack with a weapon you are proficient with you can take a -5 penalty to the attack roll in exchange for +10 damage on a hit.
callingMaterial.featHelp.32: If you take the Attack action you can use a bonus action to shove a creature within 5 feet with your shield. You add your shield's AC bonus to Dexterity saves against effects that target only you, and you can use a reaction to take no damage on a successful Dexterity save.
callingMaterial.featHelp.33: You can hide when lightly obscured, missing with a ranged attack does not reveal your position, and dim light does not impose disadvantage on your Perception checks that rely on sight.
callingMaterial.featHelp.34: The range of your attack-roll spells doubles, they ignore half and three-quarters cover, and you learn one attack cantrip from the bard, cleric, druid, sorcerer, warlock or wizard list.
callingMaterial.featHelp.35: Increase your Strength or Constitution by 1, to a maximum of 20. You are proficient with improvised weapons, your unarmed strike deals 1d4 damage, and when you hit with an unarmed strike or improvised weapon you can use a bonus action to try to grapple.
callingMaterial.featHelp.36: Your hit point maximum increases by twice your level, and by 2 more each time you gain a level.
callingMaterial.featHelp.37: You have advantage on Constitution saves to maintain concentration, you can cast with somatic components while holding weapons or a shield, and you can cast a one-action spell targeting one creature as an opportunity attack.
callingMaterial.featHelp.38: Increase your Strength or Dexterity by 1, to a maximum of 20, and gain proficiency with four weapons of your choice.
callingMaterial.featHelp.39: Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma by 1, to a maximum of 20. You learn misty step and one 1st-level divination or enchantment spell, each castable once per long rest without a slot as well as with slots.
callingMaterial.featHelp.40: Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma by 1, to a maximum of 20. You learn invisibility and one 1st-level illusion or necromancy spell, each castable once per long rest without a slot as well as with slots.
callingMaterial.featHelp.41: Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma by 1, to a maximum of 20. You learn mage hand and can cast it without components at 30 extra feet, and as a bonus action you can shove a creature within 30 feet 5 feet on a failed Strength save.
callingMaterial.featHelp.42: Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma by 1, to a maximum of 20. You can speak telepathically to any creature within 60 feet that shares a language with you, and you can cast detect thoughts once per long rest without a slot.
callingMaterial.featHelp.43: You learn one Eldritch Invocation of your choice whose prerequisites you meet. You can replace it when you gain a level.
callingMaterial.featHelp.44: You learn two Metamagic options from the sorcerer list and gain 2 sorcery points to spend on them, refilled on a long rest.
callingMaterial.featHelp.45: Increase one ability score by 1, to a maximum of 20. You gain proficiency in one skill, and expertise in one skill you are already proficient in.
callingMaterial.featHelp.46: Increase your Constitution or Wisdom by 1, to a maximum of 20, and gain proficiency with cook's utensils. Cooking during a short rest lets allies regain an extra 1d8 hit points, and an hour's work makes treats that grant temporary hit points.
callingMaterial.featHelp.47: Increase your Strength or Constitution by 1, to a maximum of 20. Once per turn when you deal bludgeoning damage you can move the creature 5 feet, and a critical hit with bludgeoning damage gives attackers advantage against it until your next turn.
callingMaterial.featHelp.48: Increase your Strength or Dexterity by 1, to a maximum of 20. Once per turn when you deal piercing damage you can reroll one damage die, and a critical hit with piercing damage adds one extra damage die.
callingMaterial.featHelp.49: Increase your Strength or Dexterity by 1, to a maximum of 20. Once per turn when you deal slashing damage you can reduce the target's speed by 10 feet, and a critical hit with slashing damage gives it disadvantage on attack rolls until your next turn.
callingMaterial.featHelp.50: You ignore resistance to poison damage, you can coat a weapon as a bonus action so its next hit forces a DC 14 Constitution save for 2d8 poison damage and the poisoned condition, and you gain proficiency with the poisoner's kit.
callingMaterial.featHelp.51: Increase your Dexterity by 1, to a maximum of 20. You gain proficiency with firearms, ignore their loading property, and being within 5 feet of a hostile creature gives you no disadvantage on ranged attacks.
callingMaterial.featHelp.52: Your guard never quite drops. Add 5 to every initiative roll you make. While you are conscious no ambush catches you off guard, and an attacker hidden from your sight gets no advantage against you merely because you cannot see it.
callingMaterial.featHelp.53: Pick any three skills or tools, in any combination, and gain proficiency with each. This feat raises no ability score.

entryCharacter.pregen.brakk.blurb: Hits first and asks later. Swing the greataxe, shrug off blows, and keep the others alive by standing in front of them.
entryCharacter.pregen.brakk.backstory: Raised in the high passes, Brakk came down to the lowlands when the herds died, and has not found a reason to go back.
entryCharacter.pregen.kara.blurb: Shield, sword and chain mail. The steadiest hand at the table: hard to hit, harder to move, and always has a plan for the door.
entryCharacter.pregen.kara.backstory: Ten years in a river baron's guard, mustered out when the baron ran out of money. Still salutes by habit.
entryCharacter.pregen.vex.blurb: Locks, shadows and a rapier. Scout ahead, find the trap before it finds you, and strike where it hurts.
entryCharacter.pregen.vex.backstory: Left a city guild one step ahead of a debt. Keeps a list of people who are owed, and a shorter list of people who are owed by Vex.
entryCharacter.pregen.sera.blurb: Mace, shield and a healer's hands. Keeps the party standing with Cure Wounds and Bless, and can hold a line herself.
entryCharacter.pregen.sera.backstory: A chapel orphan who learned that a steady voice and a steadier hand do more good than a sermon.
