handMaterial.rules.spell.contact_other_p: The server rolls the caster's DC 15 INT save as the casting is paid: a failure is 6d6 psychic and insanity until a long rest. The five answers are the DM's.
handMaterial.rules.spell.contagion: On a hit the creature is afflicted with the disease the caster picks (afflict); it deals no damage of its own.
handMaterial.rules.spell.plane_shift: On a hit the creature makes a Charisma save or is sent to the plane the caster names; it deals no damage.
handMaterial.rules.spell.bless: Up to three creatures, one more per slot level above 1st; concentration.
handMaterial.rules.spell.bane: Up to three targets, one more per slot level above 1st; concentration.
handMaterial.rules.spell.mage_armor: Ends early if the target dons armor.
handMaterial.rules.spell.haste: When the spell ends the target cannot move or act until after its next turn; the server applies the lethargy.
handMaterial.rules.spell.polymorph: Pass variant with the beast form (e.g. 'giant ape', 'tyrannosaurus rex'); the server applies the form's full stat block. The beast's CR must not exceed the target's level. Concentration; ends early at 0 beast HP.
handMaterial.rules.spell.slow: Up to six creatures in a 40-foot cube; each saves again at the end of its turns. Concentration.
handMaterial.rules.spell.dominate_person: The caster commands the charmed creature; it saves again each time it takes damage (the server rolls it). Concentration.
handMaterial.rules.spell.dominate_beast: The caster commands the charmed beast; it saves again each time it takes damage (the server rolls it). Concentration.
handMaterial.rules.spell.sleep: No saving throw: one roll of the pool for the casting, spent from the lowest hit points up. Undead and creatures immune to being charmed are not affected. A sleeper wakes when it takes damage (the server ends it) or is shaken awake.
handMaterial.rules.spell.color_spray: No saving throw: one roll of the pool for the casting, spent from the lowest hit points up; blinded until the end of the caster's next turn.
handMaterial.rules.spell.eldritch_blast: One pc_attack call for each beam: two beams at 5th level, three at 11th, four at 17th, all from the one action. Each beam is 1d10 force.
handMaterial.rules.spell.scorching_ray: One pc_attack call for each ray: three rays, one more per slot level above 2nd, all from the one slot.
handMaterial.rules.spell.wall_of_fire: Concentration. A creature that ends its turn within 10 feet of the hot side, or enters the wall, takes the same damage again: aoe_damage with the spell again spends no slot.
handMaterial.rules.spell.hunter_s_mark: Name the quarry in the condition, e.g. "hunter's mark (the ogre)".
handMaterial.rules.spell.hex: Name the target in the condition; it also has disadvantage on checks with one chosen ability.
handMaterial.rules.spell.heroism: The server grants the temporary hit points at the start of each of the target's turns.
handMaterial.rules.spell.invisibility: Ends when the target attacks or casts a spell.
handMaterial.rules.spell.spiritual_weapo: Attack with it via pc_attack, weapon 'Spiritual Weapon' (a bonus action).
handMaterial.rules.spell.faerie_fire: Each creature in a 20-foot cube saves; concentration.
handMaterial.rules.spell.magic_missile: Three darts, 1d4+1 each, +1 dart per slot level above 1st; they always hit. Name darts on cast_at_enemy to split them: the next target the same turn takes the darts left, with no second slot.
handMaterial.rules.spell.sanctuary: Attackers must first pass a WIS save or pick a new target; ends if the warded creature attacks.
handMaterial.rules.spell.hypnotic_patter: Charmed and incapacitated with a speed of 0 for the duration, no repeat save; it ends for a creature that takes damage (the server ends it) or is shaken out of it with an action.
handMaterial.rules.spell.blindness_deafn: The caster chooses blinded or deafened (pass condition); the target saves again at the end of each of its turns.
handMaterial.rules.spell.web: Restrained until it breaks free: an action and a Strength check against the caster's DC (clear_enemy_condition on a success). Fire burns the web: 2d4 fire to a creature starting its turn in the burning strands.
handMaterial.rules.spell.entangle: Restrained until the spell ends, or until it frees itself with an action and a Strength check against the caster's DC.
handMaterial.rules.spell.fear: A frightened creature drops what it holds and must Dash away each turn; it saves again only when it ends a turn out of the caster's sight.
handMaterial.rules.spell.confusion: A confused creature rolls a d10 at the start of each turn for what it does (narrate the result) and cannot take reactions.
handMaterial.rules.spell.hideous_laughte: Prone and incapacitated, unable to stand; it saves again at the end of each of its turns and each time it takes damage, with advantage then. A creature with Intelligence 4 or less is unaffected.
handMaterial.rules.spell.calm_emotions: The other choice, suppressing charm and fear on the creatures in the area, is the caster's to narrate.
handMaterial.rules.spell.banishment: Gone from the fight for the duration, with no repeat save; it returns to its space when concentration ends before a minute passes.
handMaterial.rules.spell.power_word_stun: No save: a creature with 150 hit points or fewer is stunned; it makes a CON save at the end of each of its turns.
handMaterial.rules.spell.irresistible_da: No save when cast; the dancer dances in place (no movement), and may spend its action on a WIS save to stop (take_action escape). Creatures immune to being charmed are immune.
handMaterial.rules.spell.geas: Charmed for 30 days; acting against the command deals 5d10 psychic, once a day.
handMaterial.rules.spell.spirit_guardian: An enemy that starts its turn within 15 feet makes a WIS save or takes 3d8 radiant (half on a success); the server rolls it at the start of that enemy's turn on the battle map. Speed is halved inside.
handMaterial.rules.spell.aid: Up to three creatures; each one's hit point maximum and current hit points rise by 5 (+5 a slot level above 2nd) for 8 hours.
handMaterial.rules.spell.protection_from: Pass variant with the damage type: acid, cold, fire, lightning or thunder.
handMaterial.rules.spell.warding_bond: Each time the warded creature takes damage the caster takes the same amount (apply_damage); it ends if the two are more than 60 feet apart.
handMaterial.rules.spell.enhance_ability: Pass variant with the chosen effect; Bear's Endurance also grants 2d6 temporary hit points.
handMaterial.rules.spell.fire_shield: The warm shield resists cold, the chill shield fire (pass variant). A creature within 5 feet that hits with a melee attack takes 2d8 of the other type (damage_enemy).
handMaterial.rules.spell.shillelagh: The club or quarterstaff uses the caster's spellcasting ability for attack and damage, its damage die a d8, and it is magical (a bonus action).
handMaterial.rules.spell.feather_fall: Up to five falling creatures descend 60 feet a round and take no falling damage when they land.
handMaterial.rules.spell.spike_growth: Difficult terrain; a creature takes 2d4 piercing for every 5 feet it moves through the area (damage_enemy).
handMaterial.rules.spell.call_lightning: Each later turn the caster's action calls another bolt with no slot: aoe_damage with the spell again.
handMaterial.rules.spell.moonbeam: A creature entering the beam or starting its turn there saves again (aoe_damage with the spell again spends no slot); moving the beam takes the caster's action.
handMaterial.rules.spell.flaming_sphere: A bonus action rams the sphere into a creature on later turns with no slot: cast_at_enemy with the spell again.
handMaterial.rules.spell.flame_blade: Attack with it via pc_attack, weapon 'Flame Blade' (an action each time, no slot).
handMaterial.rules.spell.mass_heal: 700 hit points divided among any number of creatures: one heal call per creature with its amount, the same turn, one slot.
handMaterial.rules.spell.dispel_magic: Ends every spell of the slot's level or lower on the target; a higher one needs a spellcasting check against DC 10 + its level (the server rolls it).
handMaterial.rules.spell.detect_thoughts: Its effect is the table's to narrate; cast it with use_spell_slot.
handMaterial.rules.spell.forcecage: The cage is laid on the battle map at atX/atY (else around the nearest creatures): no creature inside walks out, none outside walks in. Teleporting out takes a CHA save (the DM's to call).
handMaterial.rules.spell.thunderwave: A creature that fails is pushed 10 feet away from the caster; the server moves its token on a battle map.
handMaterial.rules.spell.gust_of_wind: A creature in the line that fails its Strength save is pushed 15 feet away (the server moves its token); a bonus action each later turn blows again with no slot.
handMaterial.rules.spell.vicious_mockery: On a failed save it has disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn; the server spends it on that roll.
handMaterial.rules.spell.harm: Harm cannot take the target below 1 hit point; a failed save shrinks its hit point maximum by the necrotic damage taken, for an hour.
handMaterial.rules.spell.heat_metal: The damage is automatic. The holder makes a CON save or drops a held object; one that keeps it (armor it wears: pass condition "armor") has disadvantage on attacks and checks until the caster's next turn. The server rolls it. Each later turn a bonus action repeats the damage with no slot.
handMaterial.rules.spell.charm_person: A creature the party is fighting saves with advantage (the server rolls it so). Charmed for an hour, or until the party harms it.
handMaterial.rules.spell.command: Name the word in condition: grovel lays it prone, halt stops it for its next turn (the server applies both); approach, drop and flee are narrated on its turn. No effect on undead.
handMaterial.rules.spell.suggestion: It pursues the suggested course for up to 8 hours; damage from the caster or the party ends it (the server ends it on damage). A creature that cannot be charmed is immune.
handMaterial.rules.spell.mass_suggestion: Up to twelve creatures pursue the course for 24 hours; damage from the caster or the party ends it for the one hurt.
handMaterial.rules.spell.levitate: It rises up to 20 feet and can move only by pushing or pulling on something fixed: its speed is 0 while the spell lasts.
handMaterial.rules.spell.modify_memory: Charmed and incapacitated while the caster reshapes its memory; what it remembers is narrated.
handMaterial.rules.spell.stinking_cloud: A creature that fails spends its action retching on its turn (the server holds it to that); creatures that need no breath or are immune to poison succeed. A creature starting its turn in the cloud saves again: aoe_damage with the spell again, no slot.
handMaterial.rules.spell.sleet_storm: A creature that fails falls prone, and a concentrating creature caught makes a CON save or loses its concentration (the server rolls both). Entering or starting a turn in the storm saves again: aoe_damage with the spell again, no slot.
handMaterial.rules.spell.earthquake: Each creature on the ground saves or falls prone, and a concentrating one makes a CON save or loses it. Fissures and collapsing buildings are narrated (their 5d6 through damage_enemy with source environment).
handMaterial.rules.spell.blight: No effect on undead or constructs; a plant creature saves with disadvantage and takes the maximum damage (the server applies both).
handMaterial.rules.spell.chain_lightning: The target and up to three more creatures within 30 feet of it, one more per slot level above 6th: one aoe_damage call naming them all, one slot.
handMaterial.rules.spell.acid_splash: One creature, or two standing within 5 feet of each other.
handMaterial.rules.spell.bestow_curse: Name the curse in condition: an ability (str to cha: disadvantage on its checks and saves), attacks (disadvantage on attack rolls against the caster), will (a WIS save at the start of each of its turns or it wastes its action), or necrotic (the caster's attacks and spells deal 1d8 necrotic more to it). The server holds each.
handMaterial.rules.spell.black_tentacles: A creature that fails takes 3d6 bludgeoning and is restrained; one it holds takes 3d6 at the start of each of its turns (the server rolls it). It escapes with its action and a Strength or Dexterity check against the caster's DC (take_action escape).
handMaterial.rules.spell.weird: Frightened; at the end of each of its turns it saves again or takes 4d10 psychic, a success ending the spell for it. The server rolls it.
handMaterial.rules.spell.phantasmal_kill: At the end of each of its turns the target saves again or takes 4d10 psychic (+1d10 a slot level above 4th); a success ends the spell. The server rolls it.
handMaterial.rules.spell.flesh_to_stone: Restrained; it saves at the end of each of its turns: three successes end the spell, three failures turn it to stone (the server keeps the count).
handMaterial.rules.spell.eyebite: Pass condition: unconscious (Asleep: ends on damage), frightened (Panicked: it Dashes away) or sickened (disadvantage on attacks and checks, a WIS save at the end of each turn). Each later turn the caster's action targets another creature with no slot.
handMaterial.rules.spell.sunbeam: Blinded until the caster's next turn on a failed save; undead and oozes save with disadvantage. Each later turn the caster's action sends another beam with no slot.
handMaterial.rules.spell.disintegrate: A creature this drops to 0 hit points is disintegrated: dead, with nothing left to raise but by True Resurrection or Wish.
handMaterial.rules.spell.divine_word: By its hit points on a failed save: 20 or fewer killed, 30 or fewer blinded, deafened and stunned for an hour, 40 or fewer deafened and blinded for 10 minutes, 50 or fewer deafened for a minute; a celestial, elemental, fey or fiend that fails is sent home and leaves the fight. The server applies it.
handMaterial.rules.spell.resilient_spher: Enclosed in the sphere: nothing passes in or out, so it cannot be attacked or harmed from outside, and harms nothing outside.
handMaterial.rules.spell.incendiary_clou: A creature entering the cloud or ending its turn there saves again: aoe_damage with the spell again, no slot. The cloud drifts 10 feet each turn.
handMaterial.rules.spell.blade_barrier: A creature entering the wall or starting its turn there saves again: aoe_damage with the spell again, no slot. The wall gives three-quarters cover and is difficult terrain.
handMaterial.rules.spell.ray_of_enfeeble: On a hit its Strength weapon attacks deal half damage; it makes a CON save at the end of each round to end it (the server holds both). pc_attack with the spell and no damage.
handMaterial.rules.spell.gaseous_form: A misty cloud: resistance to nonmagical damage, advantage on STR, DEX and CON saves, a 10-foot fly speed; it cannot attack or cast spells (the server refuses both).
handMaterial.rules.spell.heroes_feast: Up to twelve diners: immune to poison and to being frightened, advantage on WIS saves, and their hit point maximum and hit points rise by 2d10 for 24 hours (the server rolls it once for each).
handMaterial.rules.spell.dispel_evil_and: Celestials, elementals, fey, fiends and undead have disadvantage on attacks against the caster (the server applies it). Break Enchantment and Dismissal are narrated.
handMaterial.rules.spell.lesser_restorat: Ends one of blinded, deafened, paralyzed or poisoned on the target, one disease, or a short- or long-term madness (name it in variant: disease, madness); with none held, nothing is cast.
handMaterial.rules.spell.greater_restora: Ends one: a level of exhaustion, charmed, petrified, a curse, or an indefinite madness (name it in variant). Reduced ability scores and hit point maximums are narrated back.
handMaterial.rules.spell.remove_curse: Ends every curse on the target; a cursed magic item's attunement is broken (narrated).
handMaterial.rules.spell.power_word_kill: No save: a creature with 100 hit points or fewer dies; one with more is untouched.
handMaterial.rules.spell.mind_blank: Immune to psychic damage and to being charmed for 24 hours (the server refuses both); divination and mind reading are narrated.
handMaterial.rules.spell.foresight: Advantage on attack rolls, checks and saves, and attacks against it have disadvantage, for 8 hours (the server applies all of it).
handMaterial.rules.spell.animate_objects: Up to ten objects become creatures under the caster's command: bring them in with add_companion; their slams are their own attacks.
handMaterial.rules.spell.regenerate: The target regains 1 hit point at the start of each of its turns for an hour (the server adds it); a severed limb regrows in two minutes.
handMaterial.rules.spell.etherealness: Up to eight hours; three more willing creatures per slot level above 7th (cast again for each).
handMaterial.rules.spell.mislead: An illusory double appears where the caster stands; the invisibility ends if they attack or cast a spell.
handMaterial.rules.spell.antimagic_field: The field moves with the caster on the battle map: no spell is cast inside it and none from outside affects a creature in it. Magic items, summoned creatures and other spells' areas inside are suppressed; narrate them.
handMaterial.rules.spell.antilife_shell: The barrier moves with the caster on the battle map: no creature but an undead or a construct passes it or reaches through it in melee.
handMaterial.rules.spell.animal_shapes: Each willing creature takes a Large or smaller beast form of CR 4 or lower (variant), keeping its Intelligence, Wisdom and Charisma; damage past the form's hit points returns it to its own.
handMaterial.rules.spell.shapechange: The caster takes a beast form (variant) of CR up to their level, keeping their Intelligence, Wisdom and Charisma. A form that is not a beast is the DM's to run.
handMaterial.rules.spell.imprisonment: The chosen prison (burial, chaining, hedged prison, minimus containment, slumber) is the caster's to narrate; the creature is out of the fight until the spell is dispelled.
handMaterial.rules.spell.prismatic_spray: Each creature caught rolls a d8 for its ray (the server rolls): 1-5 10d6 fire, acid, lightning, poison or cold (half on a made DEX save); 6 indigo, restrained and petrified after three failed CON saves; 7 violet, blinded and sent to another plane on a failed WIS save at the caster's next turn; 8 two rays.
handMaterial.rules.spell.booming_blade: A melee WEAPON attack: resolve with pc_attack and the caster's weapon. On a hit the target takes 1d8 thunder (cantrip scaling) if it willingly moves before the caster's next turn.
handMaterial.rules.spell.green_flame_bla: A melee WEAPON attack via pc_attack. On a hit, a second creature within 5 feet takes fire damage equal to the spellcasting modifier (apply with damage_enemy).
handMaterial.rules.spell.magic_stone: Charged pebbles: ranged spell attacks for 1d6 + spellcasting modifier bludgeoning.
handMaterial.rules.spell.absorb_elements: Cast as a reaction to elemental damage; pick the variant matching the triggering type.
handMaterial.rules.spell.silvery_barbs: A reaction: the triggering creature rerolls its d20 and takes the lower; another creature gains advantage on one d20 roll within a minute.
handMaterial.rules.spell.cloud_of_dagger: 4d4 slashing (no save) when a creature enters the cube or starts its turn there; apply per-turn with cast_at_enemy.
handMaterial.rules.spell.draconic_mischi: Roll the mischief table each round; resolve each forced save with cast_at_enemy or cast_at_player.
handMaterial.rules.spell.life_transferen: The caster takes 4d8 necrotic damage that cannot be reduced (apply_damage), and the target regains twice the total (heal).
handMaterial.rules.spell.guardian_of_nat: Great Tree also grants 10 temporary hit points; set them with update_sheet.
handMaterial.rules.spell.wrath_of_nature: Resolve each lash, restraint, trip, and rock volley with aoe_damage or cast_at_enemy as it happens.
handMaterial.rules.spell.ravenous_void: Creatures in the sphere are restrained and take 5d10 force at the start of each of their turns.
handMaterial.react.label: Reactions
handMaterial.rider.title: Riding it
handMaterial.rules.dodge: Attacks against you roll at disadvantage until your next turn.
handMaterial.rules.disengage: Your movement provokes no opportunity attacks this turn.
handMaterial.rules.help: An ally gets advantage on their next attack against the creature you name, or on a check.
handMaterial.rules.hide: A Stealth check to slip out of sight.
handMaterial.rules.search: Perception or Investigation to find what is hidden.
handMaterial.rules.escape: Athletics or Acrobatics against the grappler's Athletics.
handMaterial.rules.stand: Getting up costs half your speed.
handMaterial.rules.ready: Name a trigger; when it happens your reaction makes the attack.
handMaterial.rules.grapple: Athletics against their Athletics or Acrobatics. Takes the place of one attack.
handMaterial.rules.shove: Knock them prone or push them 5 ft. Takes the place of one attack.
handMaterial.rules.object: Drink, pull, light, throw: say what.
handMaterial.rules.end: Done with your action, movement and bonus action.
handMaterial.rules.fastHands: Drink, pull, light, throw: say what. Fast Hands: a bonus action.
handMaterial.rules.flurry: After the Attack action: two unarmed strikes as a bonus action.
handMaterial.rules.shield: +5 AC against the attack that hit: a swing the +5 beats misses.
handMaterial.rules.uncannyDodge: Halve the damage of the attack that hit you.
handMaterial.rules.deflect: Take 1d10 + DEX + monk level off a ranged weapon hit.
handMaterial.rules.slowFall: Take five times your monk level off the fall.
handMaterial.rules.cuttingWords: Spend a Bardic Inspiration die off the roll or the damage.
handMaterial.rules.protection: Impose disadvantage on the attack: it is rolled again.
handMaterial.rules.reduceHalf: Halve the damage of the attack that hit.
handMaterial.rules.reduce: Take damage off the attack that hit.
handMaterial.rules.raiseAc: Raise the AC against the attack that hit: a swing it beats misses.
handMaterial.rules.disadvantage: The attack that hit is rolled again at disadvantage.
handMaterial.rules.resist: Resistance to the damage of the attack that hit.
handMaterial.rules.takeForAlly: Take the hit in your ally's place.
handMaterial.rules.redirect: The hit lands on the creature beside you instead.
handMaterial.rules.strikeBack: Strike back: {type} damage at the attacker.
handMaterial.rules.forceMissOne: The hit becomes a miss, for {level} level of exhaustion.
handMaterial.rules.forceMiss: The hit becomes a miss, for {level} levels of exhaustion.
handMaterial.rules.openHandProne: Open Hand Technique: on a hit it makes a DEX save or falls prone.
handMaterial.rules.openHandPush: Open Hand Technique: on a hit it makes a STR save or is pushed up to 15 feet away.
handMaterial.rules.openHandReaction: Open Hand Technique: on a hit it cannot take reactions until the end of your next turn.
handMaterial.rules.inspiration: Spend your Inspiration: advantage on this attack roll.
handMaterial.rules.stroke: If this attack misses, it hits instead. Spent only on a miss; back on a short or long rest.
handMaterial.rules.hurl: On a hit: gone through the lower planes until the end of your next turn, then 10d10 psychic unless a fiend. Once a long rest.
handMaterial.rules.rapid: {feature}: give up this attack's advantage for one more attack this turn. Only with advantage, once a turn.
handMaterial.rules.reckless: Advantage on your Strength melee attacks this turn; attacks against you have advantage until your next turn.
handMaterial.rules.stunning: 1 ki on a hit: CON save DC {dc} or stunned until your next turn.
handMaterial.rules.knockOut: A blow that drops it leaves it unconscious at 0 hit points instead of dead.
handMaterial.rules.smite: Spend a slot as the blade lands. One more d8 against undead and fiends.
handMaterial.rules.superiority: A superiority die rides this attack.
handMaterial.rules.maneuver: Name the maneuver when you play it.
handMaterial.rules.extraAttack: Extra Attack: {count} swings on this action.
handMaterial.rules.sneak: Sneak Attack +{count}d6 once a turn when it applies.
handMaterial.rules.versatile: Versatile: say two hands for the bigger die.
handMaterial.rules.meleeSpell: Melee spell attack: a creature beside you.
handMaterial.rules.rebuke: {who} makes a DEX save against 2d10 fire.
handMaterial.rules.martialArts: After the Attack action with an unarmed strike or a monk weapon: one more unarmed strike.
handMaterial.rules.frenzy: While raging in a frenzy: one melee weapon attack as a bonus action. Exhaustion when the rage ends.
handMaterial.rules.bonusWeapon: {feature}: one weapon attack as a bonus action.
handMaterial.rules.intimidatingPresence: Frightened until the end of your next turn; a creature that saves cannot be frightened by it for 24 hours.
handMaterial.rules.escapeSave: {spell}: your action for a {ability} saving throw against {against}; a success ends it.
handMaterial.rules.escapeCheck: {spell}: your action for a {ability} check against {against}; a success frees you.
handMaterial.error.dead: {who} is dead and cannot {act}. Only magic that raises the dead brings them back.
handMaterial.error.down: {who} is at 0 HP and cannot {act}. They act again once they are healed above 0.
handMaterial.error.condition: {who} is {condition} and cannot {act} until the condition ends.
handMaterial.error.held: {who} is {condition} and cannot {act} while it lasts.
handMaterial.error.surprisedReaction: {who} is surprised and has no reaction until their first turn has passed.
handMaterial.error.surprised: {who} is surprised and cannot {act} in the first round. They act from round 2.
handMaterial.error.initiative: Initiative is still being rolled, so {who} cannot {act} yet. Roll initiative for every character first.
handMaterial.error.otherTurn: It is {current}'s turn, not {who}'s. Off their own turn a character can only use their reaction.
handMaterial.error.noReaction: {who} is {condition} and cannot take a reaction.
handMaterial.error.bonusSpent: {who} has already used their bonus action this turn; {what} needs one.
handMaterial.error.actionSpent: {who} has already used their action this turn; {what} needs one. They can still move or take a bonus action, or end their turn.
handMaterial.error.actionBonusSpent: {who} has already used their action this turn; {what} needs one. They can still move, or end their turn.
handMaterial.error.hasteSpent: {who} has already used their action this turn; {what} needs one. The extra action from Haste is only for one weapon attack, Dash, Disengage, Hide or Use an Object. They can still move or take a bonus action, or end their turn.
handMaterial.error.hasteBonusSpent: {who} has already used their action this turn; {what} needs one. The extra action from Haste is only for one weapon attack, Dash, Disengage, Hide or Use an Object. They can still move, or end their turn.
handMaterial.error.reactionSpent: {who} has already used their reaction; it comes back at the start of their next turn. {what} does not happen.
handMaterial.error.castAttack: {who} spent this turn's action casting a spell, so they cannot also take the Attack action. Extra Attack belongs to the Attack action.
handMaterial.error.attackSpent: {who} has already used their action this turn, so they cannot take the Attack action.
handMaterial.error.attackOne: {who} has already made all {count} of their attack this turn. They cannot attack again; move, take a bonus action, or end their turn.
handMaterial.error.attacksSpent: {who} has already made all {count} of their attacks this turn. They cannot attack again; move, take a bonus action, or end their turn.
handMaterial.error.offhand: Attack with a light weapon first; the off-hand swing follows it.
handMaterial.error.smite: No spell slot left to smite with.
handMaterial.error.superiority: No superiority dice left until a rest.
handMaterial.error.stand: Your speed is 0, so you cannot stand up.
handMaterial.error.dash: Your speed is 0, so a Dash goes nowhere.
handMaterial.error.flurry: Flurry of Blows follows the Attack action: attack first, then spend the ki.
handMaterial.error.openHand: Open Hand Technique rides a hit of Flurry of Blows, and this attack is not one of its strikes. Spend the ki with use_resource Ki variant "flurry of blows" after the Attack action, then make the unarmed strikes with openHand.
handMaterial.error.ki: {who} has no ki point left for {feature}. It comes back after a rest.
handMaterial.error.slot: {who} has no spell slot left for {spell}.
handMaterial.error.slotLevel: {who} has no free level {level} spell slot.
handMaterial.error.slotTooLow: {spell} is a level {required} spell; it cannot be cast from a level {level} slot. Use a slot of level {required} or higher.
handMaterial.error.noSpellcasting: {who} has no Spellcasting feature and cannot cast spells.
handMaterial.error.polymorphed: {who} is polymorphed into a {form} and cannot cast spells; the form has no capacity for it. The spell waits until the transformation ends.
handMaterial.error.wildShaped: {who} is wild shaped as a {form} and cannot cast spells in beast form, cantrips included (that unlocks with Beast Spells at druid level 18). They can revert with use_resource on Wild Shape.
handMaterial.error.untrainedArmor: {who} is wearing armor they are not trained in ({armor}) and cannot cast spells in it. They cast again once it is off.
handMaterial.error.gestureHand: {spell} needs a free hand for its gestures, and both of {who}'s hands are full. They must put a weapon away or lower the shield first (unequip it on the sheet).
handMaterial.error.materialHand: {spell} needs a free hand for its material component, and both of {who}'s hands are full. They must put a weapon away or lower the shield first (unequip it on the sheet).
handMaterial.error.materialGestureHand: {spell} needs a free hand for its material component (the same hand makes the gestures), and both of {who}'s hands are full. They must put a weapon away or lower the shield first (unequip it on the sheet).
handMaterial.error.materialWarCaster: {spell} needs a free hand for its material component, and both of {who}'s hands are full; War Caster frees the gestures, not the material. They must put a weapon away or lower the shield first (unequip it on the sheet).
handMaterial.error.materialGestureWarCas: {spell} needs a free hand for its material component (the same hand makes the gestures), and both of {who}'s hands are full; War Caster frees the gestures, not the material. They must put a weapon away or lower the shield first (unequip it on the sheet).
handMaterial.error.focus: {spell} has a material component: {who} needs a component pouch or {focus} to cast it, and carries neither. Add one to the sheet. No slot was spent.
handMaterial.error.focusMaterial: {spell} has a material component ({material}): {who} needs a component pouch or {focus} to cast it, and carries neither. Add one to the sheet. No slot was spent.
handMaterial.error.materialFight: {spell} needs {material}, and {who} does not carry it (a line on the sheet that states its worth, like "{example}"). There is no buying one in the middle of a fight. No slot was spent.
handMaterial.error.materialGold: {spell} needs {material}. {who} carries none (a line on the sheet that states its worth, like "{example}") and has not the gold to buy it. No slot was spent.
handMaterial.error.materialHitDie: {spell}'s component is worth {gp} gp per Hit Die of its target: name the target so the server knows its Hit Dice. Nothing was spent.
handMaterial.error.ritualName: A ritual is a named spell with the ritual tag; name the spell being cast.
handMaterial.error.ritualUnknown: {spell} is not a spell the server knows to be a ritual; it needs a slot.
handMaterial.error.ritualTag: {spell} has no ritual tag; it cannot be cast as a ritual and needs a slot.
handMaterial.error.ritualClass: {who}'s class does not cast rituals (bards, clerics, druids and wizards do); {spell} needs a slot.
handMaterial.error.ritualFight: A ritual takes ten minutes longer than the spell; {spell} cannot be cast as one in the middle of a fight. It can be cast from a slot, or as a ritual once the fight is over.
handMaterial.error.longCasting: {spell} takes {time} to cast, far longer than a turn; it cannot be cast in the middle of a fight. It can be cast once the fight is over.
handMaterial.error.castActionSpent: {who} has already used their action this turn; casting {spell} needs one. Extra Attack gives more weapon attacks, not a second casting.
handMaterial.error.bonusOwnReaction: {who} has cast a spell with their bonus action this turn, so the only other spell they can cast on it is a cantrip with a casting time of one action; {spell} on their own turn is not one.
handMaterial.error.slotRequired: {who} has no free level {level} spell slot. {spell} needs a slot of level {required} or higher that is not yet spent.
handMaterial.error.raging: {who} is raging and cannot cast spells or concentrate on them. They can cast once the rage ends.
handMaterial.error.verbal: {spell} has a verbal component and {who} is {condition}: they cannot speak the words. A spell with no verbal component could still be cast.
handMaterial.error.bonusSpell: {who} has already cast a levelled spell this turn, so {spell} cannot be cast with the bonus action: beside a bonus action spell the only other spell of the turn is a cantrip.
handMaterial.error.afterBonusSpell: {who} has cast a spell with their bonus action this turn, so the only other spell they can cast is a cantrip with a casting time of one action. {spell} waits for another turn.
handMaterial.error.reactionSpell: {who} has already used their reaction; it comes back at the start of their next turn. {spell} is not cast.
handMaterial.error.inspiration: {who} holds no Inspiration to spend. The DM awards it with set_condition condition "inspiration"; attack without useInspiration.
handMaterial.error.noStroke: {who} does not have Stroke of Luck (a rogue's feature at 20th level); attack without strokeOfLuck.
handMaterial.error.strokeSpent: {who} has used Stroke of Luck; it comes back on a short or long rest. Attack without strokeOfLuck.
handMaterial.error.noHurl: {who} does not have Hurl Through Hell (The Fiend's 14th level feature); attack without hurlThroughHell.
handMaterial.error.hurlSpent: {who} has used Hurl Through Hell; it comes back on a long rest. Attack without hurlThroughHell.
handMaterial.error.bonusAttackTurn: A bonus-action attack is made on {who}'s own turn; it is not their turn.
handMaterial.error.offhandBonus: An attack is either the off-hand swing of two-weapon fighting or a feature's bonus attack, not both.
handMaterial.error.noMartialArts: {who} has no Martial Arts; the bonus-action unarmed strike is a monk's.
handMaterial.error.martialArmor: Martial Arts works only with no armor and no shield, and {who} wears one.
handMaterial.error.martialWeapon: Martial Arts' bonus-action attack is an unarmed strike; send weapon "unarmed strike".
handMaterial.error.martialFirstAttack: Martial Arts' bonus strike follows the Attack action taken with an unarmed strike or a monk weapon, and {who} has not attacked that way this turn. They attack first, then strike as a bonus action.
handMaterial.error.bonusWeapon: A feature's bonus-action attack is a weapon attack.
handMaterial.error.noFrenzy: {who} has no Frenzy; the bonus-action attack of a frenzy is a Berserker's.
handMaterial.error.frenzyRage: {who} is not raging; a frenzy lasts only as long as a rage. They rage first (use_resource Rage).
handMaterial.error.frenzyMelee: A frenzy's bonus-action attack is a melee weapon attack.
handMaterial.error.noStunning: {who} has no Stunning Strike (a monk's feature from 5th level).
handMaterial.error.stunningMelee: Stunning Strike rides a melee weapon attack (an unarmed strike counts), not a ranged one or a spell.
handMaterial.error.stunningKi: {who} has no ki point left for Stunning Strike. They can make the attack without it.
handMaterial.error.noReckless: {who} has no Reckless Attack (a barbarian's feature from 2nd level).
handMaterial.error.recklessTurn: Reckless Attack is declared on the barbarian's own turn.
handMaterial.error.recklessStrength: Reckless Attack covers melee weapon attacks made with Strength; this one is not.
handMaterial.error.recklessFirst: Reckless Attack is decided on the first attack of the turn, and {who} has already attacked. They can attack without it, or decide it at the start of their next turn.
handMaterial.error.knockOutRanged: Only a melee attack can knock a creature out instead of killing it; this one is ranged.
handMaterial.error.poolAmount: {feature} needs {required} {pool} and {who} has {left}. It comes back after a rest.
handMaterial.error.noHorde: {who} has no Horde Breaker (a Hunter ranger's Hunter's Prey pick).
handMaterial.error.hordeTurn: Horde Breaker's attack is made on the ranger's own turn.
handMaterial.error.hordeWeapon: Horde Breaker's extra attack is a weapon attack of its own, not an off-hand or bonus-action swing.
handMaterial.error.hordeSpent: {who} has already made their Horde Breaker attack this turn; it comes once a turn.
handMaterial.error.hordeFirst: Horde Breaker's extra attack follows a weapon attack on another creature this turn; attack that creature first.
handMaterial.error.hordeAdjacent: Horde Breaker's extra attack must target a creature within 5 feet of the creature attacked first.
handMaterial.error.noBonusWeapon: No feature of theirs grants a bonus-action weapon attack.
handMaterial.error.noBonusWeaponWho: {who}: No feature of theirs grants a bonus-action weapon attack.
handMaterial.error.bonusWeaponWhen: {feature}'s bonus-action weapon attack comes {when}, and that has not happened this turn.
handMaterial.error.bonusWeaponWhenWho: {who}: {feature}'s bonus-action weapon attack comes {when}, and that has not happened this turn.

sheetDialog.resourceHelp.inspiring_leade: Inspiring Leader (or Level Up's Rallying Speaker): ten minutes of rallying words give up to six friendly creatures within 30 feet who can hear and understand them temporary hit points equal to the speaker's level plus Charisma modifier; one use per creature (targetCharacterId), and a creature cannot benefit again until it finishes a rest.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.cyberpunk_adren: 1/short rest, take one additional action on your turn.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.cyberpunk_backu: Rebuild a destroyed drone on a long rest for free, or in 1 minute once per day.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.cyberpunk_bulle: Reaction: +3 AC against one ranged attack you can see, 3/long rest.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.cyberpunk_daemo: 1/long rest, split one single-target damaging program among up to three targets.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.cyberpunk_deus_: 1/long rest, for 1 minute your drones act independently and you may cast one routine through each.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.cyberpunk_every: 1/long rest, the DM tells you one useful secret about a person you converse with.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.cyberpunk_ghost: 1/long rest, one drone turns invisible for 1 minute.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.cyberpunk_greas: 1/short rest, reroll a failed CHA-based check.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.cyberpunk_indom: 1/long rest, reroll a failed saving throw.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.cyberpunk_jury_: 2/long rest, 10 minutes of tinkering restores a broken device or gives a tool user +1d4 for 1 hour.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.cyberpunk_kingp: 1/long rest, declare a contact anywhere; one favor within reason simply succeeds.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.cyberpunk_mirac: 1/long rest, an ally at 0 HP within 30 ft instantly regains 3d6 + WIS HP.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.cyberpunk_nanit: 1/day, regain one expended spell slot of 3rd level or lower on a short rest.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.cyberpunk_one_m: 1/long rest, an ally within 30 ft that would drop to 0 HP drops to 1 instead.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.cyberpunk_oracl: 1/long rest, ask the DM three questions about local people, places, or events; get brief true answers.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.cyberpunk_overm: 1/long rest, regain expended slot levels equal to your CHA modifier.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.cyberpunk_overw: Reaction: impose disadvantage on an attack against an ally you can see, 2/rest.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.cyberpunk_plagu: 1/short rest, touch cures any disease, poison, blindness, deafness, or paralysis.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.cyberpunk_reali: 1/long rest, your next damaging psionic deals maximum damage.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.cyberpunk_root_: 1/long rest, control a construct or networked system for 1 minute (INT save negates).
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.cyberpunk_self_: Each drone regains 2d6 HP at the start of your turn, once per rest each.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.cyberpunk_signa: 1/rest, listen in on any electronic or magical communication within 100 ft.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.cyberpunk_singu: 1/long rest, cast a psionic of 5th level or lower without a slot at two targets.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.cyberpunk_stati: 1/short rest, bonus action: +2 AC until the start of your next turn.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.cyberpunk_stim_: Bonus action touch: an ally regains 1d6 + WIS HP. Uses per long rest equal WIS modifier.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.cyberpunk_storm: 1/long rest, for 1 minute make one additional blade attack on each of your turns.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.cyberpunk_stree: 1/long rest, call in a favor: gear, a ride, a name, or entry somewhere (DM adjudicates scope).
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.cyberpunk_surge: 2/rest, cast a cantrip as a bonus action after casting a leveled psionic.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.cyberpunk_synap: 1/long rest, a creature hit by your psionic saves (WIS) or is stunned until your next turn.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.cyberpunk_the_n: Regain 4 expended slot levels on a short rest, once per day.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.cyberpunk_wired: 1/long rest while below half HP, bonus action to regain 10 + level HP.

sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_warding_fla: A reaction imposing disadvantage on one attack roll, against the cleric and, from 6th level, an ally within 30 feet.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_wrath_of_th: A reaction dealing 2d8 lightning or thunder damage to a creature that hit the cleric in melee, halved on a Dexterity save.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_war_priest: A bonus-action weapon attack after taking the Attack action. Resolve it with pc_attack.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_eyes_of_the: An action sensing undead within 60 feet, through walls but not a foot of stone or thin metal.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_sentinel_at: A reaction turning a critical hit against a creature within 30 feet into an ordinary hit.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_eyes_of_nig: Share the cleric's 300-foot darkvision with willing creatures within 10 feet for an hour.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_steps_of_ni: A bonus action in dim light or darkness granting a flying speed equal to the walking speed for 1 minute.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_balm_of_the: A pool of d6s equal to the druid's level. Spend any number as a bonus action to heal a creature within 120 feet that many d6, plus 1 temporary hit point per die.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_hidden_path: A bonus action teleporting the druid 60 feet, or a willing creature they touch 30 feet.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_spirit_tote: A bonus action raising a 30-foot Bear, Hawk or Unicorn spirit aura for 1 minute.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_faithful_su: Triggers on its own when the druid drops to 0 hit points: four dire wolves appear and defend them for an hour.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_fungal_infe: A reaction reanimating a beast or humanoid that just died within 10 feet as a zombie under the druid's command for an hour.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_star_map: Free castings of guiding bolt from the map, without a spell slot. Resolve the attack with cast_at_enemy.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_cosmic_omen: A reaction adding a d6 (Weal) or subtracting one (Woe) on an attack, check or save by a creature within 30 feet. The omen is chosen after each long rest and does not change until the next one.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_blazing_rev: Triggers when the druid drops to 0 hit points while the wildfire spirit is out: the spirit is destroyed and the druid returns at half their hit point maximum.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_walker_in_d: A free casting of dream, scrying or teleportation circle after a short rest, without a slot.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_enthralling: After a minute of performance, up to a proficiency-bonus number of humanoids within 60 feet are charmed for an hour on a failed Wisdom save.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_mantle_of_m: A bonus action granting a minute of free command castings, with listeners unable to attack the bard while charmed.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_unbreakable: A bonus action for 1 minute: an attacker must pass a Charisma save or lose the attack and be unable to target the bard that turn.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_words_of_te: A minute of private conversation frightens a humanoid for an hour on a failed Wisdom save.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_mantle_of_w: A reaction capturing the shadow of a humanoid that died within 30 feet, wearable as their identity for an hour.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_shadow_lore: A whispered secret charms a creature within 30 feet for 8 hours on a failed Wisdom save, and it obeys reasonable requests.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_infectious_: A reaction copying a successful Bardic Inspiration die onto another creature within 60 feet, without spending an inspiration use.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_performance: An action creating a nonmagical item worth up to 20 times the bard's level. A spell slot buys extra uses.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_animating_p: An action animating a Large or smaller object as a dancing item that acts on the bard's turn. A spell slot buys extra uses.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_spirit_sess: An hour-long seance granting one divination or necromancy spell, castable until the next long rest.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_zealous_pre: A bonus action granting up to ten allies within 60 feet advantage on attacks and saves until the barbarian's next turn.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_consult_the: A free casting of augury or clairvoyance using Wisdom, with no slot or components.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_magic_aware: An action sensing spells and magic items within 60 feet, through most barriers.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_bolstering_: Touch an ally to grant a bonus d3 on attacks and ability checks for 10 minutes, or restore one expended spell slot of 3rd level or lower.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_infectious_: A natural-weapon hit forces a Wisdom save: the target either attacks a creature of the barbarian's choice or takes 2d12 psychic damage.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_call_the_hu: A bonus action when raging: up to five allies each add a weapon damage die to one hit per turn, and the barbarian gains 5 temporary hit points per ally who accepts.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_hexblades_c: A bonus action cursing a creature for 1 minute: bonus damage equal to the warlock's proficiency bonus, critical hits on a 19 or 20 against it, and hit points back when it dies.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_fey_presenc: An action charming or frightening every creature in a 10-foot cube that fails a Wisdom save, until the end of the warlock's next turn.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_misty_escap: A reaction on taking damage that turns the warlock invisible and teleports them 60 feet.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_entropic_wa: A reaction imposing disadvantage on an attack; if it then misses, the warlock has advantage on their next attack against that creature.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_healing_lig: A pool of d6s equal to 1 + the warlock's level. Spend up to their Charisma modifier of them as a bonus action to heal a creature within 60 feet.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_searing_ven: Instead of rolling a death save, rise at half hit points, blinding enemies within 30 feet and dealing 2d8 + Charisma radiant damage to them.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_accursed_sp: A humanoid the warlock kills rises as an obedient specter with extra temporary hit points until the next long rest.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_tentacle_of: A bonus action summoning a spectral tentacle for 1 minute: a 10-foot reach attack for 1d8 cold damage that also halves the target's speed.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_fathomless_: Teleport the warlock and up to five willing creatures to a body of water within a mile.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_form_of_dre: A bonus action for 1 minute: 1d10 + warlock level temporary hit points, immunity to being frightened, and one creature hit each turn is frightened on a failed Wisdom save.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_necrotic_hu: Instead of dropping to 0 hit points, stay at 1 and deal necrotic damage equal to the warlock's level to each creature within 30 feet.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_spirit_proj: An hour of spirit form: resistance to most damage, movement through solid matter, and necrotic and psychic spell damage that heals the warlock.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_defy_death: Regain 1d8 + Constitution modifier hit points on succeeding at a death save or stabilizing a creature.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_indestructi: A bonus action healing 1d8 + warlock level and reattaching severed body parts.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_genies_vess: Retreat inside the vessel for up to 10 minutes; from 10th level up to five companions come too and gain temporary hit points on a short rest inside.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_limited_wis: Replicate any spell of 6th level or lower without components. In the fiction this needs several days to recharge, so grant it sparingly.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_tides_of_ch: Advantage on one attack, ability check or saving throw. The DM may trigger a Wild Magic Surge afterwards to restore the use.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_favored_by_: Add 2d4 to a failed saving throw or a missed attack, possibly turning it into a success.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_unearthly_r: A bonus action at half hit points or less, restoring hit points equal to half the sorcerer's maximum.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_strength_of: A Charisma save against 5 + the damage leaves the sorcerer at 1 hit point instead of 0.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_restore_bal: A reaction cancelling advantage or disadvantage on a roll by a creature within 60 feet.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_trance_of_o: A minute during which attacks against the sorcerer cannot have advantage and any d20 of 9 or lower counts as a 10 on their attacks, checks and saves.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_clockwork_c: A 30-foot cube healing 100 hit points among creatures in it, ending spells of 6th level or lower and repairing objects.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_warping_imp: Teleport 120 feet, pulling creatures toward the vacated space for 3d10 force damage on a failed Strength save.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_lunar_pheno: A 30-foot burst matching the current moon phase: healing, blinding radiance or a burst of speed.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_portent: Rolled after each long rest and kept as fixed numbers. Spend one to replace the result of an attack, check or save by the wizard or a creature they can see, declared before the roll.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_illusory_se: A reaction interposing an illusory duplicate so an attack that would hit misses instead.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_instinctive: A reaction redirecting an attack aimed at the wizard onto another creature within the attacker's reach, on a failed Wisdom save.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_hypnotic_ga: An action charming and incapacitating a creature within 5 feet until the end of the wizard's next turn, extendable each turn as an action.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_benign_tran: Teleport 30 feet or swap places with a willing creature. Also recharges whenever the wizard casts a conjuration spell of 1st level or higher.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_shapechange: A free self-polymorph into a beast of challenge rating 1 or lower, without a spell slot.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_bladesong: A bonus action for 1 minute: add the Intelligence modifier to AC, 10 feet of speed, advantage on Acrobatics, and a bonus on concentration saves. It ends if the wizard wears medium or heavy armor or a shield, or is incapacitated.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_chronal_shi: A reaction forcing a creature within 30 feet to reroll an attack, check or save, before or after the result is known.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_momentary_s: A Large or smaller creature within 60 feet is incapacitated and frozen in time until the end of the wizard's next turn on a failed Constitution save.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_arcane_abey: Store a spell of 4th level or lower in a bead that any creature can break to cast it, using the wizard's spellcasting numbers.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_violent_att: A reaction adding 1d10 to a weapon damage roll or 2d10 per 10 feet to falling damage within 60 feet.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_event_horiz: A minute of crushing gravity in a 30-foot radius: 2d10 force damage and no movement on a failed Strength save. A 4th-level slot buys extra uses.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_manifest_mi: A bonus action projecting the spellbook's spirit up to 300 feet, letting the wizard cast from its position. A spell slot buys extra uses.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_master_scri: After a long rest, create a spell scroll of a 1st or 2nd-level spell from the book, cast at maximum effect.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_one_with_th: Avoid death by destroying the book's magic, which then takes days of study to rebuild.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_hunters_sen: An action revealing a creature's damage immunities, resistances and vulnerabilities, or that it has none.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_magic_users: A reaction forcing a caster or teleporter within 60 feet to make a Wisdom save or lose the spell and the action.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_ethereal_st: A bonus-action etherealness lasting a single turn.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_detect_port: Sense the distance and direction to the closest planar portal within a mile.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_writhing_ti: A bonus action granting a 10-foot flying speed for 1 minute, carried by the swarm.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_swarming_di: A reaction granting resistance to the damage just taken and teleporting the ranger 30 feet.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_misty_wande: A free misty step that can bring one willing creature within 5 feet along.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_fey_reinfor: A free casting of summon fey without a spell slot; the summoned fey can turn invisible.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_drake_compa: Summon the bonded drake for an hour. It acts on the ranger's turn, adds their proficiency bonus to its rolls, and can be resummoned with a spell slot.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_drakes_brea: The drake exhales a 30-foot cone for 8d6 of its damage type, halved on a Dexterity save. A 3rd-level slot buys extra uses.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_wails_from_: After a sneak attack, a second creature within 30 feet takes half the sneak attack dice in necrotic damage.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_ghost_walk: A bonus action granting 10 minutes of spectral form: a 10-foot fly speed and movement through creatures and objects. A soul trinket buys extra uses.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_psychic_vei: An hour of invisibility, ending early if the rogue deals damage or forces a saving throw. A Psionic Energy die buys extra uses.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_rend_mind: A sneak attack with Psychic Blades stuns a creature for 1 minute on a failed Wisdom save. Three Psionic Energy dice buy extra uses.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_spell_thief: A reaction stealing a spell cast at the rogue on a failed save by the caster, denying it to them for 8 hours and letting the rogue cast it once.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_unerring_ey: An action sensing illusions, shapechangers and other magical deception within 30 feet, without learning what is hidden.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_master_duel: Reroll a missed attack, with advantage.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_wholeness_o: Spend 5 ki to return a creature dead no more than 24 hours to life with 4d10 + Wisdom hit points, free of every condition it died with.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_breath_of_t: Replace one Attack-action attack with a 20-foot cone or 30-foot line dealing the martial arts die in the monk's chosen damage type, halved on a Dexterity save. Ki buys extra uses.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_wings_unfur: While airborne, gain a flying speed equal to the walking speed for that turn.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_aspect_of_t: A bonus action raising a 10-foot aura for 1 minute that either frightens enemies or grants allies resistance to the monk's damage type. Three ki buys extra uses.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_glorious_de: A reaction adding the paladin's Charisma modifier to the AC of themselves or an ally within 10 feet; if the attack then misses, they may attack the attacker.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_undying_sen: Triggers on its own: drop to 1 hit point instead of 0.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.race_stones_end: A reaction reducing incoming damage by 1d12 + the goliath's Constitution modifier.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.race_healing_ha: Touch a creature to restore hit points equal to the aasimar's level.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.race_celestial_: A minute of transformation from 3rd level: spectral wings granting flight, and extra radiant damage once per turn.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.race_hidden_ste: A bonus action turning the firbolg invisible until the start of their next turn, or until they attack, cast or force a save.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.race_firbolg_ma: A free casting of detect magic or disguise self, using Wisdom, without a slot. Disguise self can change the firbolg's size between Medium and Small.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.race_fury_of_th: Extra damage equal to the goblin's level on a hit against a creature larger than them.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.race_hungry_jaw: A bonus-action bite that, on a hit, also grants temporary hit points equal to the lizardfolk's Constitution modifier.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.race_genasi_mag: The genasi's inherited spell, cast without a slot: burning hands, create or destroy water, levitate or pass without trace depending on their element. The matching cantrip is at will and does not use this counter.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.art_flash_of_ge: A reaction adding the artificer's Intelligence modifier to an ability check or saving throw by them or an ally within 30 feet.
sheetPlay.resourceName.art_right_tool: The Right Tool for the Job
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.art_right_tool: An hour with tinker's tools conjures any set of artisan's tools needed, lasting until the next use.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.art_experimenta: Elixirs brewed on a long rest, each with a random effect: healing, swiftness, resilience, boldness, flight or transformation. Extra elixirs can be brewed by spending a spell slot.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.art_eldritch_ca: A bonus action builds a flamethrower, force ballista or protector cannon that acts on the artificer's command. A spell slot buys extra uses.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.art_spell_stori: After a long rest, store a 1st or 2nd-level artificer spell in an item; the holder can cast it twice the artificer's Intelligence modifier in times.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.art_arcane_jolt: Once per turn, a magic-weapon or Steel Defender hit deals an extra 2d6 force damage, or heals a creature within 30 feet 2d6. Rises to 4d6 at 15th level.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.art_restorative: Free castings of lesser restoration without a spell slot.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_starry_form: A bonus action spends one Wild Shape use to take a starry form for 10 minutes: Archer (a bonus-action luminous arrow, resolved by the server), Chalice (healing spells also heal a second creature 1d8 + WIS), or Dragon (concentration saves treat a low d20 as a 10). Pass variant to choose; the constellation's mechanics apply automatically. This counter mirrors Wild Shape uses.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_embodiment_: Casting an enchantment spell of 1st level or higher as a bonus action instead of an action. Spend it with use_resource, then cast the spell with its own tool.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_cauterizing: A reaction when a creature dies near the druid or the Wildfire Spirit: the flame heals an ally (variant 'heal', targetCharacterId) or burns an enemy (variant 'burn', targetEnemyId) for 2d10 + WIS. The server rolls and applies it.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_unwavering_: The bonus-action attack against a marked creature that attacked someone else; the mark itself the server lays on every melee hit.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_bulwark_of_: A bonus action: the psi warrior and up to INT-modifier allies within 30 feet gain half cover (+2 AC, +2 DEX saves) for a minute. Once per long rest, or by spending a Psionic Energy die. The server applies it.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_telekinetic: Telekinesis once without a slot; while concentrating on it, a weapon attack as a bonus action (pc_attack bonusAttack 'feature').
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_elder_champ: An action: for a minute, 10 hit points at the start of each turn and enemies within 10 feet save at disadvantage against the paladin's spells. The server applies both.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_avenging_an: An action: for an hour, a 60-foot flying speed; enemies within 30 feet save (WIS) or are frightened, and attacks against the frightened have advantage. The server rolls the saves.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_invincible_: An action: resistance to all damage for a minute (the server applies it); the extra attack and the 19-20 critical are narrated.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_living_lege: A bonus action: advantage on Charisma checks for a minute (the server applies it); the reroll of a miss and the turned save are narrated.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_mortal_bulw: A bonus action: truesight 120 feet and advantage on attacks against aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey and fiends for a minute. The server applies the advantage.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_exalted_cha: An action: for an hour, resistance to nonmagical weapon damage and advantage on Wisdom saves. The server applies both to the paladin.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_dread_lord: An action: for a minute, attacks against the oathbreaker are at disadvantage, enemies starting a turn within 30 feet take 4d10 psychic, and a bonus-action spectral strike deals 4d10 psychic (pc_attack weapon "Dread Lord's Shadows"). The server applies all of it.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_wind_soul: An action: the sorcerer and up to 3 + CHA-modifier creatures within 30 feet gain a flying speed for an hour. The server marks them flying.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_elemental_g: A bonus action: a 30-foot flying speed for 10 minutes (use_resource 'Elemental Flight'). The resistance is chosen once with use_resource 'Elemental Gift' and the patron's type as the variant.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_defensive_f: A bonus action in Guardian armor: temporary hit points equal to the artificer level (use_resource 'Defensive Field').
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_perfected_a: A reaction in Guardian armor: a Large or smaller creature within 30 feet makes a Strength save or is pulled in and knocked prone. The server rolls it (use_reaction 'Perfected Armor').
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sub_arcane_ward: The ward's hit points: twice the wizard level plus the Intelligence modifier. The first abjuration spell of 1st level or higher after a long rest raises it at full strength, damage to the wizard lands on it first, and each later abjuration spell restores twice its level. The server keeps it; nobody spends it by hand.
Whether the Arcane Ward has been raised since the last long rest (it is raised once a day, by the first abjuration spell of 1st level or higher). The server keeps it.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.rage: A bonus action. Raging for up to 1 minute: resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage, bonus damage on melee Strength attacks, and advantage on Strength checks and saves, none of it while wearing heavy armor. The server applies all of it; the rage ends early if they end it, fall unconscious, or end a turn without having attacked or taken damage since their last one.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.ki: Ki fuels Flurry of Blows (a bonus-action pair of unarmed strikes: resolve each with pc_attack), Patient Defense (Dodge), and Step of the Wind (Dash or Disengage, doubled jump).
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sorcery_points: Sorcery points buy Metamagic on a spell being cast (spend with amount), or convert to and from spell slots: call use_resource with variant like 'create a 2nd-level slot' (costs 2/3/5/6/7 points for levels 1-5) or 'convert my 3rd-level slot into points' and the server moves the points and slots. Created slots vanish on a long rest. Quickened Spell: call use_resource with variant 'Quickened Spell' before the cast; the server spends 2 points and the next spell of one action this turn takes the bonus action. The spell itself still goes through use_spell_slot or cast_at_enemy as normal.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.luck_points: Lucky (or Level Up's Fortunate): three luck points a long rest. One spent on their own attack roll, ability check or saving throw rolls an extra d20 and keeps the best (pc_attack luck: true, request_roll luck: true; the server spends the point), or on an attack made against them (use_reaction 'lucky' after the hit: the attacker's d20 is rolled again and the lower kept; no reaction is spent).
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.ki_inner_resili: Inner Resilience (Tome of Heroes): 3 ki points for Patient Defense or Step of the Wind, 3 more on a monk's own; back after a short rest.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.superiority_dic: Martial Adept: one superiority die (a d6) for the two maneuvers the feat taught, one more on a Battle Master's own; back after a short rest.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.sorcery_points_: Metamagic Adept: 2 sorcery points for the two Metamagic options the feat taught, on top of a sorcerer's own; back after a long rest.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.second_wind: A bonus action that restores 1d10 + fighter level hit points to the fighter.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.action_surge: One additional action this turn, on top of the regular one. Resolve the extra action with its own tool call (a second pc_attack, a cast, a Dash).
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.channel_divinit: Divine power channelled into a subclass effect. Pass variant to have the server resolve it: 'turn undead' (every undead within 30 feet makes a WIS save against the spell DC; a failure is turned for a minute, and from cleric 5 an undead at or under the Destroy Undead CR is destroyed instead), 'sacred weapon' (Oath of Devotion: +CHA to weapon attack rolls for a minute), 'preserve life' (Life Domain: heals up to 5 x cleric level split among targetCharacterIds, none past half their maximum). Never apply turned or frightened by hand: the save decides it.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.bardic_inspirat: The target keeps the inspiration die for up to 10 minutes and adds it to one ability check, attack roll, or saving throw. The server hands it to them and spends it on their next roll automatically. From bard 5 (Font of Inspiration) the uses come back on a short rest too.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.wild_shape: The druid takes on a beast's form: its hit points, AC, and natural attacks, keeping their own mind. Damage spills back to their own hit points when the form drops.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.lay_on_hands: A touch that restores hit points straight from the paladin's pool: the amount spent is the amount healed. Spend 5 instead to cure one disease or neutralize one poison.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.divine_sense: Until the end of their next turn the paladin knows the location of any celestial, fiend, or undead within 60 feet that is not behind total cover, and of consecrated or desecrated ground.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.relentless_endu: This is not spent by choice: the server drops them to 1 hit point instead of 0 the next time damage would fell them, and burns the use itself.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.arcane_recovery: Once a day, on a short rest, the wizard recovers expended spell slots totalling half their level (rounded up), none of them 6th level or higher.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.natural_recover: Once a day, on a short rest, the druid recovers expended spell slots totalling half their druid level (rounded up), none of them 6th level or higher.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.breath_weapon: A cone or line of the dragonborn's ancestral damage type. Resolve it with aoe_damage using the dice, save, DC and damage type this call reports (the ancestry sets the type and the save).
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.indomitable: The fighter rerolls the saving throw they last failed and must use the new roll. The server rerolls it; on a success the condition that save put on them comes off.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.cleansing_touch: An action that ends one spell on the paladin or on a willing creature they touch. Clear what the spell left with clear_condition.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.stroke_of_luck: An attack that missed a target in range hits instead, or a failed ability check is treated as a 20 on the d20.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.inspiration: Inspiration is spent on a roll, not with use_resource: pass useInspiration on request_roll for advantage on that check, save or attack.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.relentless_rage: Not spent by choice: while raging, damage that drops them to 0 (and does not kill them outright) forces a CON save, DC 10 plus 5 for every use since their last rest, and a success leaves them at 1 hit point. The server rolls it.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.wholeness_of_bo: An action: the monk regains hit points equal to three times their monk level.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.eldritch_master: One minute spent entreating the patron: every expended Pact Magic slot comes back. The server refills them.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.signature_spell: The first spell named on Signature Spells, cast at 3rd level with no slot; the server spends it when the spell is cast.
The second spell named on Signature Spells, cast at 3rd level with no slot; the server spends it when the spell is cast.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.overchannel: Pass overchannel on cast_at_enemy or aoe_damage: the spell deals its maximum damage; after the first use each long rest the wizard takes 2d12 necrotic per spell level (1d12 more per level each further use), which the server rolls.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.dark_ones_own_l: The warlock adds a d10 to one ability check or saving throw. The server holds the die on them and adds it to their next check or save.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.hurl_through_he: After a hit, the creature vanishes through the lower planes until the end of the warlock's next turn and, unless it is a fiend, takes 10d10 psychic damage when it returns. Resolve the damage with damage_enemy (type psychic); no save is allowed.
sheetDialog.resourceHelp.mystic_arcanum_: The warlock's one 6th level arcanum is cast once without a spell slot, and again only after a long rest. Resolve the spell with its own tool.
The warlock's one 7th level arcanum is cast once without a spell slot, and again only after a long rest. Resolve the spell with its own tool.
The warlock's one 8th level arcanum is cast once without a spell slot, and again only after a long rest. Resolve the spell with its own tool.
The warlock's one 9th level arcanum is cast once without a spell slot, and again only after a long rest. Resolve the spell with its own tool.
sheetDialog.ac.manual: Set by hand; armor does not change it.
sheetDialog.load.over: Past their carrying capacity of {capacity} lb: they can only drag this load, at a speed of 5 feet, and nothing more can be given to them.
sheetDialog.load.off: Carrying capacity {capacity} lb. Encumbrance is off for this table, so weight up to the capacity costs nothing.
sheetDialog.load.unweighed: {count} {word} of unknown weight are not counted.
sheetDialog.load.encumbered: encumbered ({carried} lb of a {limit} lb limit): speed -10
sheetDialog.load.heavy: heavily encumbered ({carried} lb of a {limit} lb limit): speed -20 and disadvantage on STR, DEX and CON rolls
sheetDialog.shape.note: Damage hits the beast's hit points first. The {current}/{max} HP above is what {name} returns to when the form breaks.
sheetDialog.slots.help: Casting a spell of level I or higher uses up one slot of that level (or a higher one, to cast it stronger); cantrips never use one. Filled marks are slots still available, empty ones are spent. They all come back after a long rest{pact}.{correction}
sheetDialog.slots.pactRest: (a warlock's pact slots after a short rest too)
sheetDialog.slots.corrects: The DM marks them as spells are cast; the buttons correct the count.
sheetDialog.slots.mine: The DM marks them as you cast; the button marks one the count missed.
sheetDialog.hitDice.spendCorrection: Correction: mark a hit die as spent
